aṣṭottaraśataṃ tasya vyādhīnāṃ na bhaviṣyati .. .. 89 ..
5.95.d:
तानि चार्पय मे भूयो येनानृण्यं व्रजाम्यहम् ..
तस्या देव्याः सुराधीश त्वत्प्रसादेन सांप्रतम् .. 83 ..
एवमुक्तस्ततस्तेन भगवांस्त्रिपुरांतकः ..
आज्ञाप्य तानि सर्वाणि ददौ तत्र द्रुतं गतः .. 84 ..
अब्रवीच्च सुतस्तत्र स्वयं राजा भविष्यति ..
वीर्यौदार्यसमोपेतो वंशस्योद्धरणक्षमः .. 85 ..
त्वं चागच्छ मया सार्धमद्यैव मम मंदिरे ..
प्रविश्यात्र जले पुण्ये देवीकुण्डसमुद्भवे .. 86 ..
अद्य माघचतुर्दश्यां शुक्लायामपरोऽपि यः ..
देवीमिमां च संपूज्य जलेऽस्मिन्भक्तिसंयुतः .. 87 ..
करिष्यति प्रवेशेन प्राणत्यागं नृपोत्तम ..
स च यास्यति यत्रास्ते पाताले हाटकेश्वरः .. 88 ..
स्नानं वा पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ यः करिष्यति मानवः ..
अष्टोत्तरशतं तस्य व्याधीनां न भविष्यति .. .. 89 ..
5.95.m:
Now, by your favor, grant them back to me once more, O Lord of the gods, / so that I may become free from debt to that goddess. 83
Addressed thus by him, the Lord who destroys the three cities, / having summoned them all, went quickly and gave them there. 84
And he said: “Your son will become king there on his own, / endowed with valor and generosity, capable of uplifting the lineage. 85
And you, come with me this very day to my dwelling, / having entered here into the holy water born of the pool of the Goddess. 86
Today, on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, whatever other person / also worships this Goddess and, endowed with devotion, in this water 87
shall relinquish life by entering, O best of kings, / he too shall go to Pātāla, where Hāṭakeśvara dwells. 88
Or whatever man shall perform a ritual ablution, O best of kings, / to him the one hundred and eight diseases shall not occur.” 89

5.95.s:
evamuktvā tamādāya nṛpaṃ bhāryāsamanvitam ..
ajābhistābhirastraiśca taiścāpi parameśvaraḥ ..
praviveśa jale tasmindevīkuṇḍasamudbhave .. 6.95.90 ..
tataśca maṃdiraṃ nītaḥ svakīyaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ..
tenaiva naradehena sa kalatrasamanvitaḥ .. 91
adyāpi tiṣṭhate tatra jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ ..
pūjayānaśca taṃ devaṃ pātāle hāṭakeśvaram .. 92 ..
evaṃ tatra samudbhūtā sā devī parameśvarī ..
sthāpitā tena bhūpena śraddhāpūtena cetasā .. 93 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye'jāpāleśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 95 ..
5.95.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तमादाय नृपं भार्यासमन्वितम् ..
अजाभिस्ताभिरस्त्रैश्च तैश्चापि परमेश्वरः ..
प्रविवेश जले तस्मिन्देवीकुण्डसमुद्भवे .. 6.95.90 ..
ततश्च मंदिरं नीतः स्वकीयं द्विजसत्तमाः ..
तेनैव नरदेहेन स कलत्रसमन्वितः .. 91
अद्यापि तिष्ठते तत्र जरामरणवर्जितः ..
पूजयानश्च तं देवं पाताले हाटकेश्वरम् .. 92 ..
एवं तत्र समुद्भूता सा देवी परमेश्वरी ..
स्थापिता तेन भूपेन श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा .. 93 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽजापालेश्वरीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चनवतितमोऽध्यायः .. .. 95 ..
5.95.m:
Having spoken thus, the Supreme Lord took that king together with his wife, / along with those goats and those weapons, / and entered into that water originating from the pool of the Goddess. 90
Then, O best of twice-borns, he was led to his own abode, / in that very human body, accompanied by his wife. 91
Even today he remains there, free from old age and death, / constantly worshiping that god Hāṭakeśvara in Pātāla. 92
Thus that goddess, the Supreme Mistress, arose there, / installed by that king with a mind purified by faith. 93
Thus ends the ninety-fifth chapter, named “The Description of the Māhātmya of Ajāpāleśvarī,” in the section on the Māhātmya of Śrī-Hāṭakeśvara-kṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the auspicious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 95

5.96.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ tasmingate bhūpe hyajāpāle rasātalam ..
tatputraścābhavadrājā maṃtribhistu puraskṛtaḥ .. 1 ..
5.96.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं तस्मिन्गते भूपे ह्यजापाले रसातलम् ..
तत्पुत्रश्चाभवद्राजा मंत्रिभिस्तु पुरस्कृतः .. 1 ..
5.96.m: Sūta said: / When that king Ajapāla had thus departed to the netherworld, / his son became king, placed at the head by the ministers; 1

5.96.s:
yo nityamagamatsvarge vāsavaṃ ramate sadā ..
śanaiścaro jito yena rohiṇīṃ paribhedayan .. 2 ..
5.96.d:
यो नित्यमगमत्स्वर्गे वासवं रमते सदा ..
शनैश्चरो जितो येन रोहिणीं परिभेदयन् .. 2 ..
5.96.m: he who constantly went to heaven and always delighted Indra, / and by whom Śanaiścara was conquered as he was cleaving Rohiṇī; 2

5.96.s:
gṛhe yasya svayaṃ viṣṇurbhūtvā caiva caturvidhaḥ ..
rāvaṇasya vināśārthaṃ janma cakre praharṣitaḥ .. 3 ..
5.96.d:
गृहे यस्य स्वयं विष्णुर्भूत्वा चैव चतुर्विधः ..
रावणस्य विनाशार्थं जन्म चक्रे प्रहर्षितः .. 3 ..
5.96.m: in whose house Viṣṇu himself, becoming fourfold, / joyfully took birth for the destruction of Rāvaṇa. 3

5.96.s:
tenāgatyātra satkṣetre toṣito madhusūdanaḥ ..
prāsādaṃ śobhanaṃ kṛtvā tataścaiva pratiṣṭhitaḥ .. 4 ..
5.96.d:
तेनागत्यात्र सत्क्षेत्रे तोषितो मधुसूदनः ..
प्रासादं शोभनं कृत्वा ततश्चैव प्रतिष्ठितः .. 4 ..
5.96.m: Having come to this good sacred field, Madhusūdana was propitiated by him; / having built a beautiful temple, [the deity] was then installed by him. 4

5.96.s:
tasyāpi viśrutā vāpī svayaṃ tena vinirmitā ..
rājavāpīti loke'sminvikhyātiṃ paramāṃ gatā .. 5 ..
5.96.d:
तस्यापि विश्रुता वापी स्वयं तेन विनिर्मिता ..
राजवापीति लोकेऽस्मिन्विख्यातिं परमां गता .. 5 ..
5.96.m: A step-well built by himself also became renowned; / it attained the highest fame in this world under the name “Rājavāpī.” 5

5.96.s:
tasyāṃ yaḥ kurute śrāddhaṃ saṃprāpte pañcamīdine ..
pretapakṣe viśeṣeṇa sa naraḥ syātsatāṃ priyaḥ .. 6 ..
5.96.d:
तस्यां यः कुरुते श्राद्धं संप्राप्ते पञ्चमीदिने ..
प्रेतपक्षे विशेषेण स नरः स्यात्सतां प्रियः .. 6 ..
5.96.m: Whoever performs a śrāddha in it when the fifth day arrives, / especially during the fortnight of the departed spirits, that man becomes dear to the virtuous. 6

5.96.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kathaṃ tena jitaḥ saurī rohiṇīśakaṭaṃ ca yat ..
bhiṃdānastoṣitastena kathaṃ nārāyaṇo vada .. 7 ..
5.96.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कथं तेन जितः सौरी रोहिणीशकटं च यत् ..
भिंदानस्तोषितस्तेन कथं नारायणो वद .. 7 ..
5.96.m: The seers said: / How was Śani conquered by him as he was cleaving the cart of Rohiṇī, / and how was Nārāyaṇa propitiated by him? Tell [us]! 7

5.96.s:
.. . sūta uvāca .. ..
tasmiñchāsati dharmajñe svadharmeṇa vasundharām..
atisaukhyānvito lokaḥ sarvadaiva vyajāyata .. 8 ..
5.96.d:
.. . सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्मिञ्छासति धर्मज्ञे स्वधर्मेण वसुन्धराम्..
अतिसौख्यान्वितो लोकः सर्वदैव व्यजायत .. 8 ..
5.96.m: Sūta said: / While that knower of dharma was ruling the earth according to his own duty, / the people constantly lived endowed with supreme happiness. 8

5.96.s:
bahukṣīrapradā gāvaḥ sasyāni guṇavaṃti ca ..
kāmavarṣī ca parjanyo yatharttuphalitā drumāḥ .. 9 ..
5.96.d:
बहुक्षीरप्रदा गावः सस्यानि गुणवंति च ..
कामवर्षी च पर्जन्यो यथर्त्तुफलिता द्रुमाः .. 9 ..
5.96.m: Cows yielded abundant milk, the crops were rich in quality, / the rain-cloud showered at desire, and trees bore fruit according to the season. 9

5.96.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya daivajñaistasya bhūpateḥ ..
kathitaṃ rohiṇībhedaṃ raviputraḥ kariṣyati .. 6.96.10 ..
5.96.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य दैवज्ञैस्तस्य भूपतेः ..
कथितं रोहिणीभेदं रविपुत्रः करिष्यति .. 6.96.10 ..
5.96.m: Then, at a certain time, it was told to that king by astrologers: / “The son of the Sun will effect the cleaving of Rohiṇī. 10

5.96.s:
tasyānaṃtaramevāśu durbhikṣaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ..
anāvṛṣṭiśca bhavitā raudrā dvādaśa vārṣikī ..
yayā saṃpatsyate sarvaṃ bhūtalaṃ gatamānavam .. 11 ..
5.96.d:
तस्यानंतरमेवाशु दुर्भिक्षं संभविष्यति ..
अनावृष्टिश्च भविता रौद्रा द्वादश वार्षिकी ..
यया संपत्स्यते सर्वं भूतलं गतमानवम् .. 11 ..
5.96.m: Immediately after that, a famine will soon occur, / and there will be a terrible drought lasting twelve years, / by which the whole surface of the earth will become devoid of men.” 11

5.96.s:
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa rājā kupito'bhyagāt ..
śanaiścaraṃ samuddiśya vimānamadhiruhya ca .. 12 ..
5.96.d:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा स राजा कुपितोऽभ्यगात् ..
शनैश्चरं समुद्दिश्य विमानमधिरुह्य च .. 12 ..
5.96.m: Hearing their words, that king went angrily / against Śanaiścara, having mounted an aerial chariot. 12

5.96.s:
tasya tuṣṭena saṃdattaṃ vimānaṃ kāmagaṃ purā ..
śakreṇa tatra saṃtiṣṭhañchanaiścaramupādravat .. 13 ..
5.96.d:
तस्य तुष्टेन संदत्तं विमानं कामगं पुरा ..
शक्रेण तत्र संतिष्ठञ्छनैश्चरमुपाद्रवत् .. 13 ..
5.96.m: Formerly, an aerial chariot moving at will had been given to him by the pleased Śakra; / standing in it, he rushed against Śanaiścara. 13

5.96.s:
tataḥ sūryapathaṃ muktvā tataścaṃdrasya pārthivaḥ ..
nakṣatrasaraṇiṃ prāpya sajyaṃ kṛtvā mahaddhanuḥ .. 14
5.96.d:
ततः सूर्यपथं मुक्त्वा ततश्चंद्रस्य पार्थिवः ..
नक्षत्रसरणिं प्राप्य सज्यं कृत्वा महद्धनुः .. 14
5.96.m: Then, having crossed the path of the sun and then that of the moon, / the king, reaching the pathway of the constellations, strung his great bow. 14

5.96.s:
tatra bāṇaṃ samāropya śanaiścaramupādravat ..
provāca purataḥ sthitvā sūryaputramadhomukham .. 15 ..
5.96.d:
तत्र बाणं समारोप्य शनैश्चरमुपाद्रवत् ..
प्रोवाच पुरतः स्थित्वा सूर्यपुत्रमधोमुखम् .. 15 ..
5.96.m: Setting an arrow upon it there, he rushed at Śanaiścara, / and standing before the son of the Sun who looked downward, he said: 15

5.96.s:
tyajainaṃ rohiṇīmārgaṃ sāṃprataṃ tvaṃ śanaiścara ..
madvākyādanyathā'haṃ tvāṃ nayiṣyāmi yamakṣayam .. 16 ..
5.96.d:
त्यजैनं रोहिणीमार्गं सांप्रतं त्वं शनैश्चर ..
मद्वाक्यादन्यथाऽहं त्वां नयिष्यामि यमक्षयम् .. 16 ..
5.96.m: “Abandon this path of Rohiṇī right now, O Śanaiścara, / at my word! Otherwise I shall dispatch you to Yama's abode 16

5.96.s:
etena niśitāgrega śareṇā nataparvaṇā ..
divyāstramaṃtrayuktena satyametadbravīmyaham .. 17 ..
5.96.d:
एतेन निशिताग्रेग शरेणा नतपर्वणा ..
दिव्यास्त्रमंत्रयुक्तेन सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीम्यहम् .. 17 ..
5.96.m: with this sharp-pointed, straight-jointed arrow / charged with the mantra of a divine missile; this I tell you truthfully!” 17

5.96.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tādṛgraudratamaṃ mahat ..
mando vismayamāpannastataścedamabhāṣata .. .. 18 ..
5.96.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तादृग्रौद्रतमं महत् ..
मन्दो विस्मयमापन्नस्ततश्चेदमभाषत .. .. 18 ..
5.96.m: Hearing his speech, which was exceedingly terrible and forceful, / Śani was struck with wonder, and then spoke this: 18

5.96.s:
kastvaṃ brūhi mahābhāga mama mārgaṃ ruṇatsi yaḥ ..
agamyaṃ kenacilloke sarvairapi surāsuraiḥ .. 19 ..
5.96.d:
कस्त्वं ब्रूहि महाभाग मम मार्गं रुणत्सि यः ..
अगम्यं केनचिल्लोके सर्वैरपि सुरासुरैः .. 19 ..
5.96.m: “Tell me, who are you, O noble one, who obstruct my path / that is inaccessible to anyone in the world, even to all the gods and demons?” 19

5.96.s:
rājovāca .. ..
ahaṃ daśaratho nāma sūryavaṃśodbhavo nṛpaḥ ..
ajasya tanayaḥ prāptaḥ kāmaṃ vārayituṃ krudhā .. 6.96.20 ..
5.96.d:
राजोवाच .. ..
अहं दशरथो नाम सूर्यवंशोद्भवो नृपः ..
अजस्य तनयः प्राप्तः कामं वारयितुं क्रुधा .. 6.96.20 ..
5.96.m: The king said: / “I am the king named Daśaratha, born in the Solar Dynasty, / the son of Aja; I have arrived in anger to restrain your desire!” 20

5.96.s:
.. maṃda uvāca .. ..
na tvayā saha saṃbaṃdhaḥ kaścidasti mahīpate ..
mama yattvaṃ prakopāḍhyo manmārgaṃ haṃtumicchasi .. 21 ..
5.96.d:
.. मंद उवाच .. ..
न त्वया सह संबंधः कश्चिदस्ति महीपते ..
मम यत्त्वं प्रकोपाढ्यो मन्मार्गं हंतुमिच्छसि .. 21 ..
5.96.m: Śani said: / “There is no connection between you and me, O lord of the earth, / such that you, filled with intense fury, wish to destroy my path.” 21

5.96.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
rohiṇīsaṃbhavaṃ tvaṃ hi śakaṭaṃ bhedayiṣyasi ..
sāṃprataṃ mama daivajñairvākyametadudāhṛtam .. 22 ..
5.96.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
रोहिणीसंभवं त्वं हि शकटं भेदयिष्यसि ..
सांप्रतं मम दैवज्ञैर्वाक्यमेतदुदाहृतम् .. 22 ..
5.96.m:
The king said:
"Indeed, you are going to pierce the cart belonging to Rohiṇī.
Just now this statement was declared to me by astrologers.

5.96.s:
tasminmanda tvayā bhinne na varṣati śatakratuḥ ..
etadvadati daivajñā jyotiḥśāstravicakṣaṇāḥ .. 23 ..
5.96.d:
तस्मिन्मन्द त्वया भिन्ने न वर्षति शतक्रतुः ..
एतद्वदति दैवज्ञा ज्योतिःशास्त्रविचक्षणाः .. 23 ..
5.96.m:
O Slow-moving One, when that is pierced by you, Śatakratu does not send rain;
so say the astrologers skilled in the science of astronomy.

5.96.s:
jāte vṛṣṭinirodhe'tha jāyaṃte'nnāni na kṣitau ..
annābhāvātkṣayaṃ yāṃti tato bhūbhitale janāḥ .. 24 ..
5.96.d:
जाते वृष्टिनिरोधेऽथ जायंतेऽन्नानि न क्षितौ ..
अन्नाभावात्क्षयं यांति ततो भूभितले जनाः .. 24 ..
5.96.m:
When a blockage of rain occurs, grains do not grow upon the earth;
from the lack of food, people upon the face of the earth then meet with destruction.

5.96.s:
janocchede tato jāte agniṣṭomādikāḥ kriyāḥ ..
na bhavaṃti dharā pṛṣṭhe tataḥ syādeva saṃkṣayaḥ.. 25 ..
5.96.d:
जनोच्छेदे ततो जाते अग्निष्टोमादिकाः क्रियाः ..
न भवंति धरा पृष्ठे ततः स्यादेव संक्षयः.. 25 ..
5.96.m:
When the destruction of people then takes place, rites like Agniṣṭoma and the rest
do not occur on the surface of the earth; from that utter ruin would indeed ensue.

5.96.s:
etasmātkāraṇādruddho mārgaste sūryasaṃbhava ..
rohiṇīṃ gaṃtukāmasya satyametanmayoditam ..26..
5.96.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्रुद्धो मार्गस्ते सूर्यसंभव ..
रोहिणीं गंतुकामस्य सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् ..26..
5.96.m:
For this reason, O Sun-born, your path has been blocked [by me]
as you desire to go to Rohiṇī. The truth has been spoken by me."

5.96.s:
.. śaniruvāca .. ..
gaccha putra nijaṃ gehaṃ mamāpi tvaṃ ca rocase ..
tuṣṭo'haṃ tava vīryeṇa na tvanyena mahīpate..27..
5.96.d:
.. शनिरुवाच .. ..
गच्छ पुत्र निजं गेहं ममापि त्वं च रोचसे ..
तुष्टोऽहं तव वीर्येण न त्वन्येन महीपते..27..
5.96.m:
Śani said:
"Go to your own home, my son; you are pleasing to me as well.
I am pleased by your valour, not by anything else, O king.

5.96.s:
na kenacitkṛtaṃ karma yadetadbhavatā kṛtam ..
na kariṣyati caivānyo devo vā mānavo'tha vā .. 28 ..
5.96.d:
न केनचित्कृतं कर्म यदेतद्भवता कृतम् ..
न करिष्यति चैवान्यो देवो वा मानवोऽथ वा .. 28 ..
5.96.m:
No one has performed the deed which has been performed by you;
nor will anyone else, whether god or mortal, ever perform it.

5.96.s:
nāhaṃ paśyāmi bhūpāla kathaṃcidapi tūrdhvataḥ..
yato dṛṣṭivinirdagdhaṃ bhasmasājjāyate'khilam .. 29 ..
5.96.d:
नाहं पश्यामि भूपाल कथंचिदपि तूर्ध्वतः..
यतो दृष्टिविनिर्दग्धं भस्मसाज्जायतेऽखिलम् .. 29 ..
5.96.m:
I do not look upwards in any way whatsoever, O protector of the earth,
because whatever is consumed by my glance is reduced to ashes.

5.96.s:
jātamātreṇa bālena mayā pādau nirīkṣitau ..
tātasya sahasā dagdhau tato'haṃ vāritoṃ'bayā .. 6.96.30 ..
5.96.d:
जातमात्रेण बालेन मया पादौ निरीक्षितौ ..
तातस्य सहसा दग्धौ ततोऽहं वारितोंऽबया .. 6.96.30 ..
5.96.m:
As soon as I was born as a child, the feet of my father
were gazed upon by me; they were instantly burnt; therefore I was restrained by my mother:

5.96.s:
na tvayā putra draṣṭavyaṃ kiṃcideva kathaṃcana ..
pramāṇaṃ yadi te dharmo mātṛvākyasamudbhavaḥ .. 31 ..
5.96.d:
न त्वया पुत्र द्रष्टव्यं किंचिदेव कथंचन ..
प्रमाणं यदि ते धर्मो मातृवाक्यसमुद्भवः .. 31 ..
5.96.m:
'You must not look at anything whatsoever, O son,
if dharma arising from a mother’s word is authoritative for you.'

5.96.s:
tasmāttvayā mahatkarma kṛtamīdṛksuduṣkaram ..
prajānāṃ pārthivaśreṣṭha tyaktvā dūrādbhayaṃ mama .. 32 ..
5.96.d:
तस्मात्त्वया महत्कर्म कृतमीदृक्सुदुष्करम् ..
प्रजानां पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ त्यक्त्वा दूराद्भयं मम .. 32 ..
5.96.m:
Therefore a great deed, so very hard to accomplish, has been done by you
for the sake of the subjects, O best of rulers, casting far away all fear of me.

5.96.s:
tasmā ttava kṛte nāhaṃ bhedayiṣyāmi rohiṇīm ..
kathaṃcidapi bhūpāla yugāṃtararaśateṣvapi .. 33 ..
5.96.d:
तस्मा त्तव कृते नाहं भेदयिष्यामि रोहिणीम् ..
कथंचिदपि भूपाल युगांतररशतेष्वपि .. 33 ..
5.96.m:
Therefore, for your sake, I shall not pierce Rohiṇī
in any way whatsoever, O protector of the earth, even in hundreds of cosmic ages.

5.96.s:
varaṃ varaya cāsmākaṃ tasmādadya bhaviṣyati ..
hṛtatsthitaṃ durlabhaṃ bhūpa sarveṣāmiha dehinām .. 34 ..
5.96.d:
वरं वरय चास्माकं तस्मादद्य भविष्यति ..
हृतत्स्थितं दुर्लभं भूप सर्वेषामिह देहिनाम् .. 34 ..
5.96.m:
Choose a boon from me; therefore today it shall come to pass,
whatever is placed in your heart, hard to obtain for all embodied beings here, O king."

5.96.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
tava yo vāsare prāpte tailābhyaṃgaṃ karoti vai ..
tasyā'nyadivasaṃ yāvatpīḍā kāryā na ca tvayā .. 35 ..
5.96.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
तव यो वासरे प्राप्ते तैलाभ्यंगं करोति वै ..
तस्याऽन्यदिवसं यावत्पीडा कार्या न च त्वया .. 35 ..
5.96.m:
The king said:
"Whoever rubs himself with oil when your day has arrived,
no affliction should be caused by you to him until another day.

5.96.s:
tiladānaṃ karotyevaṃ lohadānaṃ ca yastava ..
karoti divase śaktyā yāvadvarṣaṃ tvayā hi saḥ .. 36 ..
5.96.d:
तिलदानं करोत्येवं लोहदानं च यस्तव ..
करोति दिवसे शक्त्या यावद्वर्षं त्वया हि सः .. 36 ..
5.96.m:
Likewise, he who offers gifts of sesame and gifts of iron according to his capacity
on your day, he should surely be protected by you for an entire year

5.96.s:
rakṣaṇīyaḥ sukṛcchreṣu saṃkaṭeṣu sadaiva hi ..
tvayi gocarapīḍāyāṃ saṃsthite cārkasaṃbhava .. 37 ..
5.96.d:
रक्षणीयः सुकृच्छ्रेषु संकटेषु सदैव हि ..
त्वयि गोचरपीडायां संस्थिते चार्कसंभव .. 37 ..
5.96.m:
in severe distresses and troubles, always indeed.
And when you are stationed causing transit-affliction, O Sun-born,

5.96.s:
yaḥ kuryācchāṃtikaṃ samyaktilahomaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ ..
vāsare tava saṃprāpte samidbhiśca tathā'kṣataiḥ .. 38 ..
5.96.d:
यः कुर्याच्छांतिकं सम्यक्तिलहोमं च भक्तितः ..
वासरे तव संप्राप्ते समिद्भिश्च तथाऽक्षतैः .. 38 ..
5.96.m:
he who properly performs an appeasement rite and oblation of sesame with devotion,
with firewood sticks and unbroken grains when your day arrives,

5.96.s:
tasya sārdhāni varṣāṇi sapta kāryā prayatnataḥ ..
tvayā rakṣā mahābhāga varaṃ cenmama yacchasi .. 39 ..
5.96.d:
तस्य सार्धानि वर्षाणि सप्त कार्या प्रयत्नतः ..
त्वया रक्षा महाभाग वरं चेन्मम यच्छसि .. 39 ..
5.96.m:
protection should be carefully provided by you for him for seven and a half years,
O fortunate one, if you grant me a boon."

5.96.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamityeva saṃprocya virarāma tataḥ param ..
śanaiścaro mahīpālavacanāddvijasattamāḥ .. 6.96.40 ..
5.96.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमित्येव संप्रोच्य विरराम ततः परम् ..
शनैश्चरो महीपालवचनाद्द्विजसत्तमाः .. 6.96.40 ..
5.96.m:
Sūta said:
Having said 'So be it!', Śanaiścara fell silent thereafter
at the request of the ruler of the earth, O best of brahmins.

5.96.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ suvistarāt ..
bhavadbhiḥ sūryaputrasya rājñā daśarathena hi ..
saṃvādaṃ rohiṇībhede sañjātaṃ samupasthite .. 41 ..
5.96.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽहं सुविस्तरात् ..
भवद्भिः सूर्यपुत्रस्य राज्ञा दशरथेन हि ..
संवादं रोहिणीभेदे सञ्जातं समुपस्थिते .. 41 ..
5.96.m:
All this has been related to you in full detail, just as I was asked
by you all, concerning the dialogue between the son of the Sun
and King Daśaratha that took place when the piercing of Rohiṇī was imminent.

5.96.s:
yaścaitatpaṭhate nityaṃ śṛṇuyādyo viśeṣataḥ ..
śanaiścarakṛtā pīḍā tasya nāśaṃ pragacchati .. 42 ..
5.96.d:
यश्चैतत्पठते नित्यं शृणुयाद्यो विशेषतः ..
शनैश्चरकृता पीडा तस्य नाशं प्रगच्छति .. 42 ..
5.96.m:
Whoever recites this daily, and whoever especially hears it,
all affliction caused by Śanaiścara goes to destruction for him.

5.96.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye daśarathaśanaiścarasaṃvādavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṇṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 96 .. .. cha ..
5.96.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये दशरथशनैश्चरसंवादवर्णनंनाम षण्णवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 96 .. .. छ ..
5.96.m: Thus ends the ninety-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Dialogue Between Daśaratha and Śanaiścara', in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvarakṣetra in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [book] in the Śrī Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.97.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tataḥ prabhṛti no mando rohiṇīśakaṭaṃ dvijāḥ ..
bhinatti vacanāttasya rājño daśarathasya ca .. 1 ..
5.97.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततः प्रभृति नो मन्दो रोहिणीशकटं द्विजाः ..
भिनत्ति वचनात्तस्य राज्ञो दशरथस्य च .. 1 ..
5.97.m:
Sūta said:
From that time onwards, O twice-born, the Slow-moving One does not pierce
the cart of Rohiṇī, in accordance with the word of that King Daśaratha.

5.97.s:
tadvṛttāṃtaṃ samākarṇya tasya śakraḥ praharṣitaḥ ..
bhūpālaṃ taṃ samabhyetya tataścovāca sādaram .. 2 ..
5.97.d:
तद्वृत्तांतं समाकर्ण्य तस्य शक्रः प्रहर्षितः ..
भूपालं तं समभ्येत्य ततश्चोवाच सादरम् .. 2 ..
5.97.m:
Having heard that account of his, Śakra was exceedingly delighted;
approaching that ruler of the earth, he then said with respect:

5.97.s:
atyadbhutataraṃ karma tvayaitatpṛthivīpate ..
saṃsādhitaṃ yadanyena manasāpi na cintyate .. 3 ..
5.97.d:
अत्यद्भुततरं कर्म त्वयैतत्पृथिवीपते ..
संसाधितं यदन्येन मनसापि न चिन्त्यते .. 3 ..
5.97.m:
"A most wondrous deed has been accomplished by you, O lord of the earth,
one that cannot even be conceived in mind by anyone else.

5.97.s:
ata eva hi saṃtuṣṭiḥ sañjātādya tavopari ..
varaṃ matto gṛhāṇādya tadabhīṣṭaṃ hṛdi sthitam .. 4 ..
5.97.d:
अत एव हि संतुष्टिः सञ्जाताद्य तवोपरि ..
वरं मत्तो गृहाणाद्य तदभीष्टं हृदि स्थितम् .. 4 ..
5.97.m:
For this very reason, great satisfaction has arisen in me towards you today;
receive a boon today from me, whatever desire resides in your heart."

5.97.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
tvayā saha suraśreṣṭha maitrī saṃprārthayāmyaham ..
śāśvatī sarvakṛtyeṣu paramāṃ lokasaṃsthitām ..5..
5.97.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
त्वया सह सुरश्रेष्ठ मैत्री संप्रार्थयाम्यहम् ..
शाश्वती सर्वकृत्येषु परमां लोकसंस्थिताम् ..5..
5.97.m:
The king said:
"I pray for friendship with you, O best among the gods,
a supreme, eternal friendship standing in the world in all undertakings."

5.97.s:
.. indra uvāca ..
evaṃ bhavatu rājeṃdra tvayā saha sadā mama ..
saṃpatsyate sadā maitrī vasoriva ca śāśvatī .. 6 ..
5.97.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच ..
एवं भवतु राजेंद्र त्वया सह सदा मम ..
संपत्स्यते सदा मैत्री वसोरिव च शाश्वती .. 6 ..
5.97.m:
Indra said:
"Let it be so, O king of kings; always with you my
friendship will ever be established, eternal like that with Vasu.

5.97.s:
tvayā sadaiva me pārśve sabhāyāṃ devasaṃnidhau ..
āgantavyaṃ viśeṣeṇa yena maitrī pravardhate..7..
5.97.d:
त्वया सदैव मे पार्श्वे सभायां देवसंनिधौ ..
आगन्तव्यं विशेषेण येन मैत्री प्रवर्धते..7..
5.97.m:
You must always come beside me into the assembly in the presence of the gods,
especially so that our friendship may flourish."

5.97.s:
evamuktvā sahasrākṣo jagāma tridivālayam ..
rājāpi cāgato harmye svakīye harṣasaṃyutaḥ ..8..
5.97.d:
एवमुक्त्वा सहस्राक्षो जगाम त्रिदिवालयम् ..
राजापि चागतो हर्म्ये स्वकीये हर्षसंयुतः ..8..
5.97.m:
Having spoken thus, the Thousand-Eyed One went to his celestial abode;
the king also, filled with joy, returned to his own palace,

5.97.s:
rakṣayitvā jagatsarvaṃ śanaiścara kṛtādbhayāt ..
aprāpyāṃ prāpya saṃkīrtiṃ stūyamānastu bandibhiḥ .. 9 ..
5.97.d:
रक्षयित्वा जगत्सर्वं शनैश्चर कृताद्भयात् ..
अप्राप्यां प्राप्य संकीर्तिं स्तूयमानस्तु बन्दिभिः .. 9 ..
5.97.m:
having protected the entire world from the fear caused by Śanaiścara,
having attained unobtainable renown, being praised by bards.

5.97.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti nityaṃ sa sandhyākāla upasthite ..
sāyāhnaṃ saṃvidhāyātha yāti śakrasya maṃdire ..6.97.10....
5.97.d:
ततः प्रभृति नित्यं स सन्ध्याकाल उपस्थिते ..
सायाह्नं संविधायाथ याति शक्रस्य मंदिरे ..6.97.10....
5.97.m:
From that time onwards, daily when the time of twilight arrived,
having performed the evening rites, he would go to the palace of Śakra.

5.97.s:
tatra sthitvā ciraṃ śrutvā gaṃdharvāṇāṃ manoharam ..
gītaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca nṛtyaṃ ca tānādivihitaṃ śubham ..11....
5.97.d:
तत्र स्थित्वा चिरं श्रुत्वा गंधर्वाणां मनोहरम् ..
गीतं दृष्ट्वा च नृत्यं च तानादिविहितं शुभम् ..11....
5.97.m:
Staying there for a long time, having listened to the enchanting song
of the Gandharvas and seen their auspicious dance performed with musical notes and rhythm,

5.97.s:
vicitrārthāḥ kathāḥ śrutvā devarṣīṇāṃ mukhāccyutāḥ ..
svayaṃ ca kīrtayitvātha prayāti nijamaṃdiram..12..
5.97.d:
विचित्रार्थाः कथाः श्रुत्वा देवर्षीणां मुखाच्च्युताः ..
स्वयं च कीर्तयित्वाथ प्रयाति निजमंदिरम्..12..
5.97.m:
having heard stories of wondrous meaning issuing from the mouths of the celestial seers,
and having himself related [stories], he would depart for his own palace,

5.97.s:
vimānavaramāruhya haṃsabarhiṇanāditam..
manoharapatākābhiḥ samaṃtācca vibhūṣitam..13..
5.97.d:
विमानवरमारुह्य हंसबर्हिणनादितम्..
मनोहरपताकाभिः समंताच्च विभूषितम्..13..
5.97.m:
having mounted an excellent aerial chariot resounded with geese and peacocks,
and adorned all around with charming banners.

5.97.s:
yadāyadā sa niryāti śakrasthānānnijālayam..
tadātadā''sane tasya kriyate'bhyukṣaṇaṃ sadā..14..
5.97.d:
यदायदा स निर्याति शक्रस्थानान्निजालयम्..
तदातदा'ऽसने तस्य क्रियतेऽभ्युक्षणं सदा..14..
5.97.m:
Whenever he departed from the abode of Śakra to his own home,
every time a sprinkling of water was performed on his seat,

5.97.s:
śakrādeśāttadā vetti na sa bhūpaḥ kathaṃcana ..
anyasmindivase tasya nārado munisattamaḥ ..
kathayāmāsa tatsarvamabhyukṣaṇasamudbhavam .. 15 ..
5.97.d:
शक्रादेशात्तदा वेत्ति न स भूपः कथंचन ..
अन्यस्मिन्दिवसे तस्य नारदो मुनिसत्तमः ..
कथयामास तत्सर्वमभ्युक्षणसमुद्भवम् .. 15 ..
5.97.m:
by order of Śakra. The king did not know of it in any way.
On another day, Nārada, the best of sages,

5.97.s:
vṛttāṃtaṃ tasya rājarṣestasyaiva gṛhamāgataḥ ..
tīrthayātrā prasaṃgena vidveṣaparivṛddhaye .. 16 ..
5.97.d:
वृत्तांतं तस्य राजर्षेस्तस्यैव गृहमागतः ..
तीर्थयात्रा प्रसंगेन विद्वेषपरिवृद्धये .. 16 ..
5.97.m:
having come to his very house on the occasion of a pilgrimage to sacred fords,
told the royal seer that entire story concerning the sprinkling, in order to increase animosity.

5.97.s:
tacchrutvā nāradenoktaṃ śraddheyamapi bhūpatiḥ ..
na cakre hṛdaye'dharmamātmānaṃ pariciṃtayan .. 17 ..
5.97.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा नारदेनोक्तं श्रद्धेयमपि भूपतिः ..
न चक्रे हृदयेऽधर्ममात्मानं परिचिंतयन् .. 17 ..
5.97.m:
Having heard that spoken by Nārada, though trustworthy, the king
did not entertain ill-feeling in his heart, reflecting upon himself.

5.97.s:
tathāpi kautukāviṣṭo gatvā śakraniveśanam ..
anyasmindivase sthitvā ciraṃ tatra samutthitaḥ .. 18 ..
5.97.d:
तथापि कौतुकाविष्टो गत्वा शक्रनिवेशनम् ..
अन्यस्मिन्दिवसे स्थित्वा चिरं तत्र समुत्थितः .. 18 ..
5.97.m:
Nevertheless, seized with curiosity, having gone to the dwelling of Śakra
on another day and remained there for a long time, he stood up.

5.97.s:
alakṣyaṃ vīkṣayāmāsa svāsanaṃ dūramāsthitaḥ ..
kiṃcitsadmāṃtaraṃ prāpya kautūhalasamanvitaḥ .. 19 ..
5.97.d:
अलक्ष्यं वीक्षयामास स्वासनं दूरमास्थितः ..
किंचित्सद्मांतरं प्राप्य कौतूहलसमन्वितः .. 19 ..
5.97.m:
Standing far away, having reached another room, full of curiosity,
he watched his seat invisibly.

5.97.s:
tataḥ śakrasamādeśādutthāya surakiṃkaraḥ ..
prokṣayāmāsa toyena pārthivasya tadāsanam .. 6.97.20 ..
5.97.d:
ततः शक्रसमादेशादुत्थाय सुरकिंकरः ..
प्रोक्षयामास तोयेन पार्थिवस्य तदासनम् .. 6.97.20 ..
5.97.m: Then, by Śakra's command, a servant of the gods stood up / and sprinkled water upon that seat of the earthly king.

5.97.s:
taddṛṣṭvā kopasaṃpannaḥ sa rājā'bhyetya vāsavam ..
provāca kimidaṃ śakra prokṣyate yanmamāsanam .. 21 ..
5.97.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा कोपसंपन्नः स राजाऽभ्येत्य वासवम् ..
प्रोवाच किमिदं शक्र प्रोक्ष्यते यन्ममासनम् .. 21 ..
5.97.m: Seeing that, the king, filled with anger, approached Vāsava / and said: "What is this, Śakra, that my seat is sprinkled?

5.97.s:
kiṃ mayā nihatā viprāḥ kiṃ vā viprasamudbhavam ..
śāsanaṃ lopitaṃ kiṃcitkiṃ vā viprā viniṃditāḥ .. 22 ..
5.97.d:
किं मया निहता विप्राः किं वा विप्रसमुद्भवम् ..
शासनं लोपितं किंचित्किं वा विप्रा विनिंदिताः .. 22 ..
5.97.m: Were brahmins killed by me? Or was any royal edict / originating from a brahmin violated? Or were brahmins reviled?

5.97.s:
kiṃ vā naṣṭo'smi saṃgrāme dṛṣṭvā śatrūnsamāgatān ..
dainyaṃ vā jalpitaṃ teṣāṃ bhayatrastena cetasā .. 23 ..
5.97.d:
किं वा नष्टोऽस्मि संग्रामे दृष्ट्वा शत्रून्समागतान् ..
दैन्यं वा जल्पितं तेषां भयत्रस्तेन चेतसा .. 23 ..
5.97.m: Or did I flee in battle upon seeing enemies arrive? / Or was servile pleading spoken to them by a mind trembling with fear?

5.97.s:
mama rājye'thavā śakra durbalo balavattaraiḥ ..
pīr̤yate vātha caurādyairmuṣyate vaṃcakaistathā .. 24 ..
5.97.d:
मम राज्येऽथवा शक्र दुर्बलो बलवत्तरैः ..
पीर्̤यते वाथ चौराद्यैर्मुष्यते वंचकैस्तथा .. 24 ..
5.97.m: Or in my realm, Śakra, is a weak person oppressed by stronger ones, / or robbed by thieves and the like, as well as by cheats?

5.97.s:
kiṃ vā rājye madīye ca jāyate yoniviplavaḥ ..
saṃkaro vātha varṇānāṃ parityaktavidhikramaḥ .. 25 ..
5.97.d:
किं वा राज्ये मदीये च जायते योनिविप्लवः ..
संकरो वाथ वर्णानां परित्यक्तविधिक्रमः .. 25 ..
5.97.m: Or does corruption of wombs occur in my realm, / or a confusion of castes, abandoning the sequence of prescribed rules?

5.97.s:
kiṃ vā durjanavākyena dūṣito doṣavarjitaḥ ..
daṃḍyate mama rājye ca kenacittridaśeśvara .. 26 ..
5.97.d:
किं वा दुर्जनवाक्येन दूषितो दोषवर्जितः ..
दंड्यते मम राज्ये च केनचित्त्रिदशेश्वर .. 26 ..
5.97.m: Or, on the word of a wicked person, is one free of fault falsely accused / and punished by anyone in my realm, lord of the thirty [gods]?

5.97.s:
kiṃ vā cauro'tha pāpo vā gṛhīto doṣavānsvayam ..
mucyate dravyalobhena tathānyo vā jugupsitaḥ .. 27 ..
5.97.d:
किं वा चौरोऽथ पापो वा गृहीतो दोषवान्स्वयम् ..
मुच्यते द्रव्यलोभेन तथान्यो वा जुगुप्सितः .. 27 ..
5.97.m: Or is a thief or sinner, caught in personal fault, / released out of greed for wealth, or any other despicable person?

5.97.s:
kiṃsvinmayā parityaktaḥ ko'pyatra śaraṇāgataḥ ..
bhayatrastaḥ subhītena prāṇānāṃ tridaśādhipa .. 28 ..
5.97.d:
किंस्विन्मया परित्यक्तः कोऽप्यत्र शरणागतः ..
भयत्रस्तः सुभीतेन प्राणानां त्रिदशाधिप .. 28 ..
5.97.m: Did I perhaps abandon someone who took refuge here, / trembling with fear, while I myself was terrified for my life, lord of the thirty [gods]?

5.97.s:
kasya vā pṛṣṭhamāṃsāni bhakṣitāni mayā kvacit ..
kaccicca tridaśādhīṣa brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ .. 29 ..
5.97.d:
कस्य वा पृष्ठमांसानि भक्षितानि मया क्वचित् ..
कच्चिच्च त्रिदशाधीष ब्राह्मणस्य विशेषतः .. 29 ..
5.97.m: Or whose flesh from the back have I ever eaten [by slandering]? / Did I, ruler of the thirty [gods], especially [eat] that of a brahmin?

5.97.s:
kiṃ vā dānaṃ mayā dattvā brāhmaṇāya mahātmane .. paścāttāpaḥ
kṛtaḥ paścāddattaṃ copekṣitaṃ ca vā .. 6.97.30 ..
5.97.d:
किं वा दानं मया दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणाय महात्मने .. पश्चात्तापः
कृतः पश्चाद्दत्तं चोपेक्षितं च वा .. 6.97.30 ..
5.97.m: Or having given a gift to a noble brahmin, / did I regret it afterwards, or neglect what was given?

5.97.s:
kiṃ vā rājye madīye ca dīnānāṃ prapataṃti ca ..
aśrupātā divārātraṃ duḥkhitānāṃ samaṃtataḥ .. 31 ..
5.97.d:
किं वा राज्ये मदीये च दीनानां प्रपतंति च ..
अश्रुपाता दिवारात्रं दुःखितानां समंततः .. 31 ..
5.97.m: Or in my realm, do the tears of the wretched, / of the afflicted, fall day and night on every side?

5.97.s:
daivaṃ vā paitṛkaṃ vāpi kiṃ vā karma gṛhe mama ..
lopaṃ gacchati devendra kriyate vā vidhicyutam .. 32 ..
5.97.d:
दैवं वा पैतृकं वापि किं वा कर्म गृहे मम ..
लोपं गच्छति देवेन्द्र क्रियते वा विधिच्युतम् .. 32 ..
5.97.m: Or does a rite for the gods or for the ancestors in my house, / king of the gods, suffer neglect, or is it performed contrary to rule?

5.97.s:
yattvayā kriyate nityaṃ toyairabhyukṣaṇaṃ mama ..
āsanasya drutaṃ brūyā yatpāpaṃ vihitaṃ mayā .. .. 33 ..
5.97.d:
यत्त्वया क्रियते नित्यं तोयैरभ्युक्षणं मम ..
आसनस्य द्रुतं ब्रूया यत्पापं विहितं मया .. .. 33 ..
5.97.m: Since this sprinkling of my seat with water is constantly done by you, / tell me quickly what sin was committed by me!"

5.97.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
na vidyate mahārāja śarīre tava pātakam ..
na rāṣṭre ca kule gehe bhṛtyavarge viśeṣataḥ .. 34 ..
5.97.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
न विद्यते महाराज शरीरे तव पातकम् ..
न राष्ट्रे च कुले गेहे भृत्यवर्गे विशेषतः .. 34 ..
5.97.m: Indra said: / "O great king, there is no sin in your body, / nor in your kingdom, family, house, and especially in your attendants.

5.97.s:
paraṃ śṛṇu pravakṣyāmi yatte pāpaṃ bhaviṣyati ..
tena saṃprokṣyate caiva āsanaṃ sarvadaiva tu .. 35 ..
5.97.d:
परं शृणु प्रवक्ष्यामि यत्ते पापं भविष्यति ..
तेन संप्रोक्ष्यते चैव आसनं सर्वदैव तु .. 35 ..
5.97.m: Listen further, however, and I shall tell you what sin will be yours; / because of that, your seat is always sprinkled.

5.97.s:
aputrasya gatirnāsti na ca svargaṃ prapadyate ..
paitṛkeṇa naro grasto ya ṛṇena sadā nṛpa .. 36 ..
5.97.d:
अपुत्रस्य गतिर्नास्ति न च स्वर्गं प्रपद्यते ..
पैतृकेण नरो ग्रस्तो य ऋणेन सदा नृप .. 36 ..
5.97.m: A childless man has no [good] destiny, nor does he attain heaven, / a man who is ever bound by debt to the ancestors, O king.

5.97.s:
dveṣyatāṃ yāti devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ..
yadā paśyati putrasya vadanaṃ puruṣo nṛpa .. 37 ..
5.97.d:
द्वेष्यतां याति देवानां पितॄणां च विशेषतः ..
यदा पश्यति पुत्रस्य वदनं पुरुषो नृप .. 37 ..
5.97.m: He incurs the hatred of the gods, and especially of the ancestors. / When a man gazes upon the face of a son, O king,

5.97.s:
ānṛṇyaṃ samavāpnoti pitṝṇāṃ sa tadā dhruvam ..
sa tvaṃ naiva gato rājannānṛṇyaṃ yanmayoditam .. 38 ..
5.97.d:
आनृण्यं समवाप्नोति पितॄणां स तदा ध्रुवम् ..
स त्वं नैव गतो राजन्नानृण्यं यन्मयोदितम् .. 38 ..
5.97.m: he certainly attains freedom from debt to the ancestors then. / You have not at all attained that freedom from debt which I have stated,

5.97.s:
pitṝṇāṃ tena te nityamāsane'bhyukṣaṇaṃ kṛtam ..
tasmādyatasva putrārthaṃ yadīcchasi parāṃ gatim .. 39 ..
5.97.d:
पितॄणां तेन ते नित्यमासनेऽभ्युक्षणं कृतम् ..
तस्माद्यतस्व पुत्रार्थं यदीच्छसि परां गतिम् .. 39 ..
5.97.m: the [debt] to the ancestors; therefore sprinkling was constantly done on your seat. / Therefore strive for a son, if you desire the highest state,

5.97.s:
ātmānaṃ narakāttrātuṃ puṃsaṃjñācca tathā nṛpa ..
evamuktaḥ sa śakreṇa rājā daśarathastadā .. 6.97.40 ..
5.97.d:
आत्मानं नरकात्त्रातुं पुंसंज्ञाच्च तथा नृप ..
एवमुक्तः स शक्रेण राजा दशरथस्तदा .. 6.97.40 ..
5.97.m: and to protect yourself from the hell called 'Put', O king." / Thus addressed by Śakra at that time, King Daśaratha,

5.97.s:
duḥkhena mahatā yukto lajjayā'dhomukhaḥ sthitaḥ ..
āmaṃtryātha sahasrākṣaṃ gatvā'yodhyāṃ nijāṃ purīm ..
amātyānāṃ nijaṃ rājyamarpayāmāsa satvaraḥ .. 41 ..
5.97.d:
दुःखेन महता युक्तो लज्जयाऽधोमुखः स्थितः ..
आमंत्र्याथ सहस्राक्षं गत्वाऽयोध्यां निजां पुरीम् ..
अमात्यानां निजं राज्यमर्पयामास सत्वरः .. 41 ..
5.97.m: seized by great grief, stood with head bowed down in shame. / Then, bidding farewell to the thousand-eyed [Indra] and going to his own city Ayodhyā, / he quickly entrusted his kingdom to his ministers.

5.97.s:
tataḥ provāca tānsarvāṃstapaḥ kāryaṃ mayā'dhunā ..
yāvatputrasya saṃprāptistāvadeva na saṃśayaḥ ..42..
5.97.d:
ततः प्रोवाच तान्सर्वांस्तपः कार्यं मयाऽधुना ..
यावत्पुत्रस्य संप्राप्तिस्तावदेव न संशयः ..42..
5.97.m: Then he said to them all: "Austerity must now be undertaken by me / until the attainment of a son—just so long, without doubt.

5.97.s:
etadrājyaṃ prayatnena rakṣaṇīyaṃ yathāvidhi ..
yuṣmābhirmama vākyena yāvadāgamanaṃ mama ..43..
5.97.d:
एतद्राज्यं प्रयत्नेन रक्षणीयं यथाविधि ..
युष्माभिर्मम वाक्येन यावदागमनं मम ..43..
5.97.m: This kingdom must be diligently protected according to rule / by you, at my word, until my return."

5.97.s:
.. maṃtriṇa ūcuḥ .. ..
yuktametanmahārāja putrārthaṃ yatsamudyamaḥ ..
kriyate putrahīnasya kiṃ rājyena dhanena vā .. .. 44 ..
5.97.d:
.. मंत्रिण ऊचुः .. ..
युक्तमेतन्महाराज पुत्रार्थं यत्समुद्यमः ..
क्रियते पुत्रहीनस्य किं राज्येन धनेन वा .. .. 44 ..
5.97.m: The ministers said: / "This is fitting, O great king, that an effort is made / for the sake of a son. For one without a son, what use is a kingdom or wealth?

5.97.s:
vayaṃ rakṣāṃ kariṣyāmastava rājye samaṃtataḥ ..
nirvṛtiṃ tvaṃ samāsthāya kuru putrakṛte tapaḥ .. 45 ..
5.97.d:
वयं रक्षां करिष्यामस्तव राज्ये समंततः ..
निर्वृतिं त्वं समास्थाय कुरु पुत्रकृते तपः .. 45 ..
5.97.m: We shall maintain protection over your kingdom everywhere; / attaining peace of mind, perform austerity for the sake of a son,

5.97.s:
kārtikeyapuraṃ gatvā yatra pitrā purā tava ..
tapastaptaṃ yathā labdhā siddhiśca manasepsitā .. 46 ..
5.97.d:
कार्तिकेयपुरं गत्वा यत्र पित्रा पुरा तव ..
तपस्तप्तं यथा लब्धा सिद्धिश्च मनसेप्सिता .. 46 ..
5.97.m: having gone to Kārtikeyapura, where formerly by your father / austerity was performed, so that the perfection desired by his heart was attained."

5.97.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetra māhātmye daśarathakṛtatapaḥsamudyogavarṇanaṃnāma saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 97 ..
5.97.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये दशरथकृततपःसमुद्योगवर्णनंनाम सप्तनवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 97 ..
5.97.m: Thus ends the ninety-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Undertaking of Austerity by Daśaratha', in the Māhātmya of the Holy Hāṭakeśvara Field in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

5.98.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tato daśaratho rājā maṃtribhistairvisarjitaḥ ..
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ saṃprāpto harṣasaṃyutaḥ .. 1 ..
5.98.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततो दशरथो राजा मंत्रिभिस्तैर्विसर्जितः ..
हाटकेश्वरजं क्षेत्रं संप्राप्तो हर्षसंयुतः .. 1 ..
5.98.m: Sūta said: / Then King Daśaratha, dismissed by those ministers, / arrived filled with joy at the field born of Hāṭakeśvara.

5.98.s:
tatrāgatya tato devīṃ pitrā saṃsthāpitā purā ..
pūjayitvā'tha sadbhaktyā snātvā kuṇḍe śubhodake .. 2 ..
5.98.d:
तत्रागत्य ततो देवीं पित्रा संस्थापिता पुरा ..
पूजयित्वाऽथ सद्भक्त्या स्नात्वा कुण्डे शुभोदके .. 2 ..
5.98.m: Having arrived there, having bathed in the pool of auspicious waters, / and having then worshipped with true devotion the Goddess formerly established by his father,

5.98.s:
tato'nyāni ca mukhyāni dṛṣṭvā cāyatanāni saḥ ..
snātvā tīrtheṣvanekeṣu dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ .. 3 ..
5.98.d:
ततोऽन्यानि च मुख्यानि दृष्ट्वा चायतनानि सः ..
स्नात्वा तीर्थेष्वनेकेषु दत्त्वा दानान्यनेकशः .. 3 ..
5.98.m: he then saw other principal shrines; / having bathed at many sacred fords and given gifts in many ways,

5.98.s:
prāsādaṃ kārayāmāsa devadevasya cakriṇaḥ ..
tatra saṃsthāpayāmāsa pratimāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ śubhām .. 4 ..
5.98.d:
प्रासादं कारयामास देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः ..
तत्र संस्थापयामास प्रतिमां वैष्णवीं शुभाम् .. 4 ..
5.98.m: he had a temple built for the disc-bearing God of gods, / and there installed an auspicious Vaiṣṇava image.

5.98.s:
tasyāgre kārayāmāsa vāpīṃ svacchodakānvitām ..
sopānapaṃktibhiryuktāṃ sādhubhiḥ saṃpraśaṃsitām.. 5 ..
5.98.d:
तस्याग्रे कारयामास वापीं स्वच्छोदकान्विताम् ..
सोपानपंक्तिभिर्युक्तां साधुभिः संप्रशंसिताम्.. 5 ..
5.98.m: In front of it he caused a stepped pond to be made, endowed with clear water, / furnished with rows of steps and praised by virtuous men.

5.98.s:
udakena tatastasyā devārādhanatatparaḥ ..
prakārairbahubhistīvraṃ cakāra sumahattapaḥ .. 6 ..
5.98.d:
उदकेन ततस्तस्या देवाराधनतत्परः ..
प्रकारैर्बहुभिस्तीव्रं चकार सुमहत्तपः .. 6 ..
5.98.m: Then, intent upon worshipping the deity with its water, / he performed fierce and very great austerity in many ways.

5.98.s:
tato varṣaśate'tīte tasya tuṣṭo janārdanaḥ ..
vilokya ca tapastīvraṃ vihitaṃ tena bhūbhujā .. 7 ..
5.98.d:
ततो वर्षशतेऽतीते तस्य तुष्टो जनार्दनः ..
विलोक्य च तपस्तीव्रं विहितं तेन भूभुजा .. 7 ..
5.98.m: Then, when a hundred years had passed, Janārdana was pleased with him, / having observed the fierce austerity performed by that king.

5.98.s:
provāca darśanaṃ gatvā pakṣirājaṃ samāśritaḥ ..
meghagambhīrayāvācā bahudevagaṇairvṛtaḥ .. 8 ..
5.98.d:
प्रोवाच दर्शनं गत्वा पक्षिराजं समाश्रितः ..
मेघगम्भीरयावाचा बहुदेवगणैर्वृतः .. 8 ..
5.98.m: Mounted on the king of birds [Garuḍa], surrounded by numerous hosts of gods, / appearing [before him], he spoke in a voice deep as a thundercloud.

5.98.s:
.. śrīviṣṇuruvāca .. ..
parituṣṭo'smi te vatsa varaṃ varaya suvrata ..
api te durlabhaṃ kāmamahaṃ dāsyāmi kṛtsnaśaḥ .. 9 ..
5.98.d:
.. श्रीविष्णुरुवाच .. ..
परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते वत्स वरं वरय सुव्रत ..
अपि ते दुर्लभं काममहं दास्यामि कृत्स्नशः .. 9 ..
5.98.m: Glorious Viṣṇu said: / "I am well pleased with you, child; choose a boon, O man of virtuous vows! / Even if your desire is difficult to attain, I will grant it in full."

5.98.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
putrārtho'yaṃ samāraṃbho mayā deva kṛto'khilaḥ ..
tapaso dehi me putrāṃstasmādvaṃśavivṛddhidān .. 6.98.10 ..
5.98.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
पुत्रार्थोऽयं समारंभो मया देव कृतोऽखिलः ..
तपसो देहि मे पुत्रांस्तस्माद्वंशविवृद्धिदान् .. 6.98.10 ..
5.98.m: The king said: / "This entire undertaking of austerity, O Lord, was made by me for the sake of a son; / therefore grant me sons who will cause the increase of my lineage.

5.98.s:
anyatsarvaṃ surādhīśa dhruvamasti gṛhe sthitam ..
prasādāttava yatkiṃcidvaibhavaṃ vidyate mama .. 11 ..
5.98.d:
अन्यत्सर्वं सुराधीश ध्रुवमस्ति गृहे स्थितम् ..
प्रसादात्तव यत्किंचिद्वैभवं विद्यते मम .. 11 ..
5.98.m: Everything else, ruler of the gods, is certainly present in my home; / whatever majesty exists for me is due to your grace."

5.98.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
ahaṃ tava gṛhe rājansvayameva na saṃśayaḥ ..
avatāraṃ kariṣyāmi kṛtvā rūpacatuṣṭayam.. 12 ..
5.98.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
अहं तव गृहे राजन्स्वयमेव न संशयः ..
अवतारं करिष्यामि कृत्वा रूपचतुष्टयम्.. 12 ..
5.98.m: Viṣṇu said: / "O king, I myself, having assumed four forms, / shall descend into your house; of this there is no doubt.

5.98.s:
devakāryāya tasmāttvaṃ gṛhaṃ gatvā mahīpate ..
kuru rājyaṃ yathānyāyaṃ pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mahat .. 13 ..
5.98.d:
देवकार्याय तस्मात्त्वं गृहं गत्वा महीपते ..
कुरु राज्यं यथान्यायं पितृपैतामहं महत् .. 13 ..
5.98.m: Therefore, for the business of the gods, go home, O ruler of the earth, / and rule the great kingdom of your fathers and grandfathers according to law.

5.98.s:
tatheyaṃ yā tvayā vāpī nirmitā vimalodakā ..
rājavāpīti vikhyātā loke seyaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 14 ..
5.98.d:
तथेयं या त्वया वापी निर्मिता विमलोदका ..
राजवापीति विख्याता लोके सेयं भविष्यति .. 14 ..
5.98.m: Likewise, this stepped pond of pure waters constructed by you / shall become famous in the world as the 'Rājavāpī'."

5.98.s:
asyāṃ snātvā naro bhaktyā ya enāṃ pūjayiṣyati ..
śraddhayā parayā yuktaḥ saṃprāpte paṃcamīdine .. 15 ..
5.98.d:
अस्यां स्नात्वा नरो भक्त्या य एनां पूजयिष्यति ..
श्रद्धया परया युक्तः संप्राप्ते पंचमीदिने .. 15 ..
5.98.m: The man who, bathed in this [well] with devotion, shall worship it / endowed with supreme faith when the fifth day arrives,

5.98.s:
tataḥ kariṣyati śrāddhaṃ yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ nṛpa ..
aputraḥ prāpsyate putrānvaṃśavṛddhikarānsa hi .. 16 ..
5.98.d:
ततः करिष्यति श्राद्धं यावत्संवत्सरं नृप ..
अपुत्रः प्राप्स्यते पुत्रान्वंशवृद्धिकरान्स हि .. 16 ..
5.98.m: and then shall perform a śrāddha for a full year, O king— / childless though he be, he will indeed obtain sons who increase his lineage.

5.98.s:
evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
prahṛṣṭavadano bhūtvā so'pi rājā yayau gṛham .. 17 ..
5.98.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवांस्ततश्चादर्शनं गतः ..
प्रहृष्टवदनो भूत्वा सोऽपि राजा ययौ गृहम् .. 17 ..
5.98.m: Having spoken thus, the Lord vanished from sight; / and the king, his face delighted, went home.

5.98.s:
tataḥ stokena kālena tasya putracatuṣṭayam ..
saṃjātaṃ loke vikhyātaṃ kalatratritayasya ca .. 18 ..
5.98.d:
ततः स्तोकेन कालेन तस्य पुत्रचतुष्टयम् ..
संजातं लोके विख्यातं कलत्रत्रितयस्य च .. 18 ..
5.98.m: Then, in a short time, four sons / famous in the world were born to him by his three wives.

5.98.s:
kauśalyānāma vikhyātā tasya bhāryā suśobhanā ..
jyeṣṭhā tasyāṃ suto jajñe rāmākhyaḥ prathamaḥ sutaḥ .. 19 ..
5.98.d:
कौशल्यानाम विख्याता तस्य भार्या सुशोभना ..
ज्येष्ठा तस्यां सुतो जज्ञे रामाख्यः प्रथमः सुतः .. 19 ..
5.98.m: The eldest, his very beautiful wife, was known by the name Kauśalyā; / upon her was born his first son, named Rāma.

5.98.s:
tathānyā kaikayī nāma tasya bhāryā kaniṣṭhikā ..
bharato nāma vikhyātastasyāḥ putro'bhavattvasau .. 6.98.20 ..
5.98.d:
तथान्या कैकयी नाम तस्य भार्या कनिष्ठिका ..
भरतो नाम विख्यातस्तस्याः पुत्रोऽभवत्त्वसौ .. 6.98.20 ..
5.98.m: Likewise another wife of his was the youngest, named Kaikeyī; / and her son was the famous one named Bharata.

5.98.s:
sumitrākhyā tathā cānyā patnī yā madhyamā sthitā ..
śatrughnalakṣmaṇau putrau tasyāṃ jātau mahābalau .. 21 ..
5.98.d:
सुमित्राख्या तथा चान्या पत्नी या मध्यमा स्थिता ..
शत्रुघ्नलक्ष्मणौ पुत्रौ तस्यां जातौ महाबलौ .. 21 ..
5.98.m: And another wife, who was the middle one, was named Sumitrā; / upon her were born two sons of great strength, Śatrughna and Lakṣmaṇa.

5.98.s:
tathānyā kanyakā caikā babhūva varavarṇinī ..
dadau yāṃ putrahīnasya lomapādasya bhūpateḥ ..22..
5.98.d:
तथान्या कन्यका चैका बभूव वरवर्णिनी ..
ददौ यां पुत्रहीनस्य लोमपादस्य भूपतेः ..22..
5.98.m: Likewise, another [child was born], a single maiden of excellent complexion, / whom he gave to the childless king Lomapāda.

5.98.s:
ānṛṇyaṃ bhūpatiḥ prāpya evaṃ daśarathastadā..
pitṝṇāṃ prayayau svargaṃ kṛtakṛtyastathā dvijāḥ .. 23 ..
5.98.d:
आनृण्यं भूपतिः प्राप्य एवं दशरथस्तदा..
पितॄणां प्रययौ स्वर्गं कृतकृत्यस्तथा द्विजाः .. 23 ..
5.98.m: Thus, having cleared his debt to his ancestors, King Daśaratha / departed for the heaven of the ancestors, his duty accomplished, O twice-born.

5.98.s:
atha rājā'bhavadrāmaḥ sārvabhaumastataḥ param..
rāvaṇo yena durdharṣo nihato devakaṃṭakaḥ .. 24 ..
5.98.d:
अथ राजाऽभवद्रामः सार्वभौमस्ततः परम्..
रावणो येन दुर्धर्षो निहतो देवकंटकः .. 24 ..
5.98.m: Then Rāma became the sovereign king after that, / by whom the unassailable Rāvaṇa, a thorn to the gods, was slain;

5.98.s:
yena rāmeśvaraścātra nirmito lakṣmaṇeśvaraḥ ..
sītādevī tathā mūrtā yena cātra pratiṣṭhitā ..25..
5.98.d:
येन रामेश्वरश्चात्र निर्मितो लक्ष्मणेश्वरः ..
सीतादेवी तथा मूर्ता येन चात्र प्रतिष्ठिता ..25..
5.98.m: by whom Rāmeśvara was erected here, and Lakṣmaṇeśvara, / and likewise the goddess Sītā was installed here in an image.

5.98.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye rājasvāmirājavāpīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 98 ..
5.98.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखंडे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये राजस्वामिराजवापीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टनवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 98 ..
5.98.m: Thus ends the ninety-eighth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Rājasvāmin and Rājavāpī', in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Mahāpurāṇa of Śrī Skanda, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

5.99.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ tatra rāmeṇa nirmitaḥ ..
rāmeśvarastathā sītā tena tatra vinirmitā .. 1 ..
5.99.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
यदेतद्भवता प्रोक्तं तत्र रामेण निर्मितः ..
रामेश्वरस्तथा सीता तेन तत्र विनिर्मिता .. 1 ..
5.99.m:
The seers said:
That which you have said: that Rāmeśvara was erected there / by Rāma, and likewise Sītā was fashioned there by him,

5.99.s:
tathā ca lakṣmaṇārthāya nirmitastena saṃśrayaḥ ..
etanmahadviruddhaṃ te pratibhāti vaco'khilam .. 2 ..
5.99.d:
तथा च लक्ष्मणार्थाय निर्मितस्तेन संश्रयः ..
एतन्महद्विरुद्धं ते प्रतिभाति वचोऽखिलम् .. 2 ..
5.99.m: and that an abode was erected by him for Lakṣmaṇa's sake— / this entire statement of yours appears to us greatly contradictory.

5.99.s:
tvayā sūta purā proktaṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇasaṃyutaḥ ..
sītayā sahitaḥ prāptaḥ kṣetre'tra prasthito vane .. 3 ..
5.99.d:
त्वया सूत पुरा प्रोक्तं रामो लक्ष्मणसंयुतः ..
सीतया सहितः प्राप्तः क्षेत्रेऽत्र प्रस्थितो वने .. 3 ..
5.99.m: Earlier you said, O Sūta, that Rāma, accompanied by Lakṣmaṇa / and together with Sītā, arrived at this sacred field as he departed for the forest;

5.99.s:
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā gayāśīrṣe lakṣmaṇena viruddhya ca ..
punaḥ saṃprasthito'raṇyaṃ krodhāviṣṭaśca taṃ prati . 4 ..
5.99.d:
श्राद्धं कृत्वा गयाशीर्षे लक्ष्मणेन विरुद्ध्य च ..
पुनः संप्रस्थितोऽरण्यं क्रोधाविष्टश्च तं प्रति . 4 ..
5.99.m: and having performed a śrāddha at Gayāśīrṣa, and quarreled with Lakṣmaṇa, / he set out again for the forest, filled with anger toward him.

5.99.s:
yattvayoktaṃ tadā tena nirmito'tra maheśvaraḥ ..
etacca sarvamācakṣva saṃdehaṃ sūtanandana .. 5 ..
5.99.d:
यत्त्वयोक्तं तदा तेन निर्मितोऽत्र महेश्वरः ..
एतच्च सर्वमाचक्ष्व संदेहं सूतनन्दन .. 5 ..
5.99.m: When you said that the Great Lord was erected here by him— / explain all of this doubt, O son of Sūta.

5.99.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atra me nāsti saṃdeho yuṣmākaṃ ca punaḥ sthitaḥ ..
tato vakṣyāmyaśeṣeṇa śrūyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥ ..
etatkṣetraṃ punaścādyaṃ na kṣayaṃ yāti kutracit .. 6 ..
5.99.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अत्र मे नास्ति संदेहो युष्माकं च पुनः स्थितः ..
ततो वक्ष्याम्यशेषेण श्रूयतां द्विजसत्तमाः ..
एतत्क्षेत्रं पुनश्चाद्यं न क्षयं याति कुत्रचित् .. 6 ..
5.99.m:
Sūta said:
In this matter I have no doubt, but one remains in you; / therefore I will explain it in full, listen, O best of the twice-born! / Furthermore, this sacred field is primeval and never undergoes destruction anywhere.

5.99.s:
anyasmindivase prāpte sa tadā raghunaṃdanaḥ ..
yadā virodhamāpannaḥ sārdhaṃ saumitriṇā saha .. 7 ..
5.99.d:
अन्यस्मिन्दिवसे प्राप्ते स तदा रघुनंदनः ..
यदा विरोधमापन्नः सार्धं सौमित्रिणा सह .. 7 ..
5.99.m: It was on another day when that descendant of Raghu arrived, / when he fell into discord together with the son of Sumitrā.

5.99.s:
etatpunardinaṃ cānyadyatra tena pratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
rāmeśvaraḥ svayaṃ bhaktyā duḥkhitena mahātmanā .. 8 ..
5.99.d:
एतत्पुनर्दिनं चान्यद्यत्र तेन प्रतिष्ठितः ..
रामेश्वरः स्वयं भक्त्या दुःखितेन महात्मना .. 8 ..
5.99.m: This, however, was another day, on which Rāmeśvara / was installed with devotion by the high-souled one himself when afflicted with grief.

5.99.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
anyasmindivase tatra kasminkāle raghūttamaḥ ..
saṃprāptastasya kiṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃjātaṃ tatprakīrtaya .. 9 .. .
5.99.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
अन्यस्मिन्दिवसे तत्र कस्मिन्काले रघूत्तमः ..
संप्राप्तस्तस्य किं दुःखं संजातं तत्प्रकीर्तय .. 9 .. .
5.99.m:
The seers said:
On what occasion did the best of the Raghus arrive / there on that other day? What sorrow arose for him? Recount that!

5.99.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kṛtvā sītāparityāgaṃ rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ ..
lokāpavādasaṃtrastastato rājyaṃ cakāra saḥ .. 6.99.10 ..
kṛtvā svarṇamayīṃ sītāṃ patnīṃ yajñaprasiddhaye ..
na sa cakre mahābhāgo bhāryāmanyāṃ kathaṃcana .. 1...
5.99.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
कृत्वा सीतापरित्यागं रामो राजीवलोचनः ..
लोकापवादसंत्रस्तस्ततो राज्यं चकार सः .. 6.99.10 ..
कृत्वा स्वर्णमयीं सीतां पत्नीं यज्ञप्रसिद्धये ..
न स चक्रे महाभागो भार्यामन्यां कथंचन .. 1...
5.99.m:
Sūta said:
Having abandoned Sītā, the lotus-eyed Rāma, / terrified of public slander, then ruled the kingdom.
Having made a golden image of Sītā as his wife for the successful completion of the sacrifice, / the illustrious one took no other wife in any way.

5.99.s:
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daśavarṣaśatāni ca ..
brahmacaryeṇa cakre sa rājyaṃ nihatakaṃṭakam .. 12 ..
tato varṣasahasrāṃte prāpte caikādaśe dvijāḥ ..
devadūtaḥ samāyāto rāmasya sadanaṃ prati ...3..
5.99.d:
दशवर्षसहस्राणि दशवर्षशतानि च ..
ब्रह्मचर्येण चक्रे स राज्यं निहतकंटकम् .. 12 ..
ततो वर्षसहस्रांते प्राप्ते चैकादशे द्विजाः ..
देवदूतः समायातो रामस्य सदनं प्रति ...3..
5.99.m:
For ten thousand years and ten hundred years, / in celibacy, he ruled the kingdom free of thorns.
Then, when the thousand-year period ended and the eleventh [thousand] arrived, O twice-born, / a messenger of the gods arrived at Rāma's dwelling.

5.99.s:
tenoktaṃ devarājena preṣito'haṃ tavāṃtikam ..
tasmātkuru samālokaṃ vijane tvaṃ mayā saha .. 14 ..
evamuktastadā tena dūtena raghunaṃdanaḥ ..
paraṃ rahaḥ samāsādya mantraṃ cakre tataḥ param .. 1-5 ..
5.99.d:
तेनोक्तं देवराजेन प्रेषितोऽहं तवांतिकम् ..
तस्मात्कुरु समालोकं विजने त्वं मया सह .. 14 ..
एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन दूतेन रघुनंदनः ..
परं रहः समासाद्य मन्त्रं चक्रे ततः परम् .. 1-5 ..
5.99.m:
By him it was said: "I have been sent into your presence by the king of the gods; / therefore hold counsel with me in private."
Addressed thus at that time by that messenger, the descendant of Raghu, / having reached a secluded chamber, then held counsel after that.

5.99.s:
tasyaivamupaviṣṭasya maṃtrasthāne mahātmanaḥ ..
bahutvādiṣṭalokasya na rahasyaṃ prajāyate .. 16 ..
5.99.d:
तस्यैवमुपविष्टस्य मंत्रस्थाने महात्मनः ..
बहुत्वादिष्टलोकस्य न रहस्यं प्रजायते .. 16 ..
5.99.m: As the high-souled one sat thus in the council chamber, / because of the multitude of his beloved people, privacy could not be attained.

5.99.s:
tataḥ kopaparītātmā dūtaḥ provāca sādaram ..
vihasya janasaṃsargaṃ dṛṣṭvaikāṃte'pi saṃsthite .. 17 ..
5.99.d:
ततः कोपपरीतात्मा दूतः प्रोवाच सादरम् ..
विहस्य जनसंसर्गं दृष्ट्वैकांतेऽपि संस्थिते .. 17 ..
5.99.m: Then the messenger, filled with anger, spoke politely, / laughing as he observed the mingling of people, even though they were situated in a secluded spot:

5.99.s:
yathā daṃṣṭrācyutaḥ sarpo nāgo vā madavarjitaḥ ..
ājñāhīnastathā rājā mānavaiḥ paribhūyate .. 18 ..
5.99.d:
यथा दंष्ट्राच्युतः सर्पो नागो वा मदवर्जितः ..
आज्ञाहीनस्तथा राजा मानवैः परिभूयते .. 18 ..
5.99.m: "Just as a serpent whose fangs have fallen out, or an elephant devoid of rut, / so a king lacking in authority is held in contempt by men.

5.99.s:
seyaṃ tava raghuśreṣṭha nājñāsti prativedmyaham ..
śakrālāpamapi tvaṃ ca naikāṃte śrotumarhasi .. 19 ..
5.99.d:
सेयं तव रघुश्रेष्ठ नाज्ञास्ति प्रतिवेद्म्यहम् ..
शक्रालापमपि त्वं च नैकांते श्रोतुमर्हसि .. 19 ..
5.99.m: I perceive, O best of the Raghus, that you have no such authority, / for you are not able to hear even Indra's conversation in private."

5.99.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kopasaṃraktalocanaḥ ..
triśākhāṃ bhṛkuṭīṃ kṛtvā tataḥ sa prāha lakṣmaṇam.. 6.99.20 ..
5.99.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कोपसंरक्तलोचनः ..
त्रिशाखां भृकुटीं कृत्वा ततः स प्राह लक्ष्मणम्.. 6.99.20 ..
5.99.m: Hearing his words, his eyes reddened with rage, / forming a three-creased frown on his brow, he then said to Lakṣmaṇa:

5.99.s:
mamātra saṃniviṣṭasya sahānena prajalpataḥ ..
yadi kaścinnaro mohādāgamiṣyati lakṣmaṇa ..
svahastena na saṃdehaḥ sūdayiṣyāmi taṃ drutam .. 21 ..
5.99.d:
ममात्र संनिविष्टस्य सहानेन प्रजल्पतः ..
यदि कश्चिन्नरो मोहादागमिष्यति लक्ष्मण ..
स्वहस्तेन न संदेहः सूदयिष्यामि तं द्रुतम् .. 21 ..
5.99.m: "While I am seated here in conversation with him, / if any man comes here out of delusion, O Lakṣmaṇa, / I will slay him swiftly with my own hand, there is no doubt.

5.99.s:
na hanmi yadi taṃ prāptamatra me dṛṣṭigocaram..
tanmā bhūnme gatiḥ śreṣṭhā dharmiṇāṃ yā prapadyate .. .. 22 ..
5.99.d:
न हन्मि यदि तं प्राप्तमत्र मे दृष्टिगोचरम्..
तन्मा भून्मे गतिः श्रेष्ठा धर्मिणां या प्रपद्यते .. .. 22 ..
5.99.m: If I do not kill anyone who enters and comes within the range of my sight here, / then may I not attain that supreme state which is attained by the righteous!

5.99.s:
evaṃ jñātvā prayatnena tvayā bhāvyamasaṃśayam ..
rājadvāri yathā kaścinna mayā vadhyate'dhunā .. 23 ..
5.99.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा प्रयत्नेन त्वया भाव्यमसंशयम् ..
राजद्वारि यथा कश्चिन्न मया वध्यतेऽधुना .. 23 ..
5.99.m: Knowing this, you must definitely be watchful with effort / at the palace gate, so that no one is now killed by me."

5.99.s:
tamomityeva saṃprocya lakṣmaṇaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ ..
rājadvāraṃ samāsādya cakāra vijanaṃ tataḥ.. 24 ..
5.99.d:
तमोमित्येव संप्रोच्य लक्ष्मणः शुभलक्षणः ..
राजद्वारं समासाद्य चकार विजनं ततः.. 24 ..
5.99.m: Having replied to him 'So be it', Lakṣmaṇa, endowed with auspicious marks, / stationed himself at the royal gate and then cleared it of people.

5.99.s:
devadūto'pi rāmeṇa samaṃ cakre tataḥ param..
maṃtraṃ śakrasamādiṣṭaṃ tathānyaiḥ svargavāsibhiḥ .. 25 ..
5.99.d:
देवदूतोऽपि रामेण समं चक्रे ततः परम्..
मंत्रं शक्रसमादिष्टं तथान्यैः स्वर्गवासिभिः .. 25 ..
5.99.m: The messenger of the gods then held counsel after that / with Rāma, as commanded by Indra and by the other dwellers of heaven.

5.99.s:
.. devadūta uvāca .. ..
tvaṃ rāvaṇavināśārthamavatīrṇo dharātale ..
sa ca vyāpādito duṣṭaḥ pāpastrailokyakaṃṭakaḥ .. 26 ..
5.99.d:
.. देवदूत उवाच .. ..
त्वं रावणविनाशार्थमवतीर्णो धरातले ..
स च व्यापादितो दुष्टः पापस्त्रैलोक्यकंटकः .. 26 ..
5.99.m:
The messenger of the gods said:
"You descended to the surface of the earth for the destruction of Rāvaṇa; / and that wicked, evil thorn to the three worlds has been slain.

5.99.s:
kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ mahābhāga deva kṛtyaṃ tvayā'dhunā ..
tasmātsaṃtu sanāthāste devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ..27..
5.99.d:
कृतं सर्वं महाभाग देव कृत्यं त्वयाऽधुना ..
तस्मात्संतु सनाथास्ते देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः..27..
5.99.m: All the work of the gods, O illustrious one, has now been done by you; / therefore let those gods, headed by Indra, have a protector!

5.99.s:
yadi te rocate citte noparodhena sāṃpratam ..
prasādaṃ kuru devānāṃ tasmādāgaccha satvaram ..
svargalokaṃ parityajya martyalokaṃ suniṃditam ..28..
5.99.d:
यदि ते रोचते चित्ते नोपरोधेन सांप्रतम् ..
प्रसादं कुरु देवानां तस्मादागच्छ सत्वरम् ..
स्वर्गलोकं परित्यज्य मर्त्यलोकं सुनिंदितम् ..28..
5.99.m: If it pleases your heart, not by coercion now, / do a favor to the gods: therefore come quickly / to the heavenly realm, abandoning this much-despised mortal world."

5.99.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etasminnaṃtare prāpto durvāsā munisattamaḥ ..
provācātha kṣudhāviṣṭaḥ kvāsau kvāsau raghūttamaḥ .. 29 ..
5.99.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तो दुर्वासा मुनिसत्तमः ..
प्रोवाचाथ क्षुधाविष्टः क्वासौ क्वासौ रघूत्तमः .. 29 ..
5.99.m:
Sūta said:
At that moment arrived the best of sages, Durvāsas; / seized with hunger, he then said: "Where is he, where is he, the best of the Raghus?"

5.99.s:
.. lakṣmaṇa uvāca .. ..
vyagraḥ sa pārthivaśreṣṭho devakāryeṇa kenacit ..
tasmādatraiva vipreṃdra muhūrtaṃ paripālaya ..6.99.30...
5.99.d:
.. लक्ष्मण उवाच .. ..
व्यग्रः स पार्थिवश्रेष्ठो देवकार्येण केनचित् ..
तस्मादत्रैव विप्रेंद्र मुहूर्तं परिपालय ..6.99.30...
5.99.m: Lakṣmaṇa said: / That best of kings is occupied with some business of the gods. / Therefore, O chief of brahmins, wait right here for a single moment,

5.99.s:
yāvatsāṃtvayate rāmo dūtaṃ śakrasamudbhavam ..
mamopari dayāṃ kṛtvā vinayāvanatasya hi .. 31 ..
5.99.d:
यावत्सांत्वयते रामो दूतं शक्रसमुद्भवम् ..
ममोपरि दयां कृत्वा विनयावनतस्य हि .. 31 ..
5.99.m: while Rāma consoles the messenger sent by Śakra, / showing compassion to me who am bowed down in humility.

5.99.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
yadi yāsyati no dṛṣṭiṃ mama drāksa raghūttamaḥ ..
śāpaṃ dattvā kulaṃ sarvaṃ taddhakṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ .. 32 ..
5.99.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
यदि यास्यति नो दृष्टिं मम द्राक्स रघूत्तमः ..
शापं दत्त्वा कुलं सर्वं तद्धक्ष्यामि न संशयः .. 32 ..
5.99.m: Durvāsas said: / If that best of the Raghu lineage does not come within my sight at once, / I will utter a curse and consume his entire family without doubt.

5.99.s:
mamāpi darśanādanyanna kiṃcidvidyate guru ..
kṛtyaṃ lakṣmaṇa yāvattvamanyanmūr̤ha prakatthase .. 33 ..
5.99.d:
ममापि दर्शनादन्यन्न किंचिद्विद्यते गुरु ..
कृत्यं लक्ष्मण यावत्त्वमन्यन्मूर्̤ह प्रकत्थसे .. 33 ..
5.99.m: Lakṣmaṇa, there is no duty more weighty than seeing me, / yet you, fool, boast of something else!

5.99.s:
tacchrutvā lakṣmaṇaścitte ciṃtayāmāsa duḥkhitaḥ ..
varaṃ me mṛtyurekasya mā bhūyātkulasaṃkṣayaḥ .. 34 ..
5.99.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणश्चित्ते चिंतयामास दुःखितः ..
वरं मे मृत्युरेकस्य मा भूयात्कुलसंक्षयः .. 34 ..
5.99.m: Hearing that, Lakṣmaṇa thought in his heart, sorrowful: / 'Better the death of me alone; let there not be the destruction of the family.'

5.99.s:
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā tato rāmamupādravat ..
uvāca daṃḍavadbhūmau praṇipatya kṛtāṃjaliḥ .. 35 ..
5.99.d:
एवं स निश्चयं कृत्वा ततो राममुपाद्रवत् ..
उवाच दंडवद्भूमौ प्रणिपत्य कृतांजलिः .. 35 ..
5.99.m: Having thus made up his mind, he then rushed toward Rāma; / prostrating like a staff upon the ground with joined palms, he said:

5.99.s:
durvāsā muniśārdūlo deva te dvāri tiṣṭhati ..
darśanārthī kṣudhāviṣṭaḥ kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām .. 36 ..
5.99.d:
दुर्वासा मुनिशार्दूलो देव ते द्वारि तिष्ठति ..
दर्शनार्थी क्षुधाविष्टः किं करोमि प्रशाधि माम् .. 36 ..
5.99.m: "O lord, Durvāsas, a tiger among sages, stands at your door, / desiring to see you, overcome with hunger. What shall I do? Command me!"

5.99.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tato dūtamuvāca tam ..
gatvemaṃ brūhi deveśaṃ mama vākyādasaṃśayam ..
ahaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃta āgamiṣyāmi teṃ'tike .. 37 ..
5.99.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ततो दूतमुवाच तम् ..
गत्वेमं ब्रूहि देवेशं मम वाक्यादसंशयम् ..
अहं संवत्सरस्यांत आगमिष्यामि तेंऽतिके .. 37 ..
5.99.m: Hearing his words, he then said to that messenger: / "Go and say this to the lord of gods, without doubt, in my words: / 'I shall come into your presence at the end of the year.'"

5.99.s:
evamuktvā visṛjyātha taṃ dūtaṃ prāha lakṣmaṇam ..
praveśaya drutaṃ vatsa taṃ tvaṃ durvāsasaṃ munim .. 38 ..
5.99.d:
एवमुक्त्वा विसृज्याथ तं दूतं प्राह लक्ष्मणम् ..
प्रवेशय द्रुतं वत्स तं त्वं दुर्वाससं मुनिम् .. 38 ..
5.99.m: Having spoken thus and dismissed the messenger, he then said to Lakṣmaṇa: / "Dear boy, quickly usher in that sage Durvāsas!"

5.99.s:
tataścārghyaṃ ca pādyaṃ ca gṛhītvā sammukho yayau ..
rāmadevaḥ prahṛṣṭātmā sacivaiḥ parivāritaḥ .. 39 ..
5.99.d:
ततश्चार्घ्यं च पाद्यं च गृहीत्वा सम्मुखो ययौ ..
रामदेवः प्रहृष्टात्मा सचिवैः परिवारितः .. 39 ..
5.99.m: Then, taking water for the respectful offering and water for washing feet, he went to meet him, / Lord Rāma, glad at heart, surrounded by his ministers.

5.99.s:
dattvārghyaṃ vidhivattasya praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ ..
provāca rāmadevo'tha harṣagadgadayā girā .. 6.99.40 ..
5.99.d:
दत्त्वार्घ्यं विधिवत्तस्य प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः ..
प्रोवाच रामदेवोऽथ हर्षगद्गदया गिरा .. 6.99.40 ..
5.99.m: Offering him the water for respectful offering according to rule, bowing down repeatedly, / Lord Rāma then spoke in a voice choked with joy:

5.99.s:
svāgataṃ te muniśreṣṭha bhūyaḥ susvāgataṃ ca te ..
etadrājyamamī putrā vibhavaśca tava prabho .. 41 ..
5.99.d:
स्वागतं ते मुनिश्रेष्ठ भूयः सुस्वागतं च ते ..
एतद्राज्यममी पुत्रा विभवश्च तव प्रभो .. 41 ..
5.99.m: "Welcome to you, O best of sages! Again, a hearty welcome to you! / This kingdom, these sons, and this wealth belong to you, O master!

5.99.s:
kṛtvā mama prasādaṃ ca gṛhāṇa munisattama ..
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi yattvaṃ me gṛhamāgataḥ ..
pūjyo lokatrayasyāpi niḥśeṣatapasāṃnidhiḥ .. 42 ..
5.99.d:
कृत्वा मम प्रसादं च गृहाण मुनिसत्तम ..
धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि यत्त्वं मे गृहमागतः ..
पूज्यो लोकत्रयस्यापि निःशेषतपसांनिधिः .. 42 ..
5.99.m: Favor me, O best of sages, and accept them! / Blessed am I, graced am I, that you have come to my home, / you who are worthy of worship even by the three worlds, a treasure of complete austerity!"

5.99.s:
.. muniruvāca .. ..
cāturmāsyavrataṃ kṛtvā nirāhāro raghūttama ..
adya te bhavanaṃ prāpya āhārārthaṃ bubhukṣitaḥ .. 43 ..
5.99.d:
.. मुनिरुवाच .. ..
चातुर्मास्यव्रतं कृत्वा निराहारो रघूत्तम ..
अद्य ते भवनं प्राप्य आहारार्थं बुभुक्षितः .. 43 ..
5.99.m: The sage said: / "Having performed the vow of the four-month rainy season without food, O best of the Raghu lineage, / today I have come to your abode hungry for a meal.

5.99.s:
tasmāttvaṃ yaccha me śīghraṃ bhojanaṃ raghunaṃdana ..
nānyena kāraṇaṃ kiṃcitsaṃnyastasya dhanādinā .. 44 ..
5.99.d:
तस्मात्त्वं यच्छ मे शीघ्रं भोजनं रघुनंदन ..
नान्येन कारणं किंचित्संन्यस्तस्य धनादिना .. 44 ..
5.99.m: Therefore, give me food quickly, O delighter of the Raghu lineage! / A renunciant has no concern with anything else, such as wealth."

5.99.s:
tatastaṃ bhojayāmāsa śraddhāpūtena cetasā ..
svayamevāgrataḥ sthitvā mṛṣṭānnairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 45 ..
5.99.d:
ततस्तं भोजयामास श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा ..
स्वयमेवाग्रतः स्थित्वा मृष्टान्नैर्विविधैः शुभैः .. 45 ..
5.99.m: Then he fed him with a heart purified by faith, / standing in front of him himself, with various wholesome sweet foods,

5.99.s:
lehyaiścoṣyaistathā carvyaiḥ khādyaireva pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
yāvadicchā munestasya tathānnairvividhairapi .. 46 ..
5.99.d:
लेह्यैश्चोष्यैस्तथा चर्व्यैः खाद्यैरेव पृथग्विधैः ..
यावदिच्छा मुनेस्तस्य तथान्नैर्विविधैरपि .. 46 ..
5.99.m: with distinct kinds of dishes to be licked, sucked, chewed, and eaten, / according to that sage's desire, and likewise with diverse foods.

5.99.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye rāmeśvarasthāpanaprastāve śrīrāmaṃprati durvāsaḥ samāgamanavṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaśatatamo' dhyāyaḥ .. 99 .. .. cha ..
5.99.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये रामेश्वरस्थापनप्रस्तावे श्रीरामंप्रति दुर्वासः समागमनवृत्तांतवर्णनंनामैकोनशततमो' ध्यायः .. 99 .. .. छ ..
5.99.m: Thus ends the ninety-ninth chapter, titled 'The Account of Durvāsas's Arrival before Śrī Rāma', in the context of the installation of Rāmeśvara, in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Great Purāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

5.100.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ bhuktvā sa viprarṣirvāṃchayā rāmamaṃdire ..
dattāśīrnirgataḥ paścādāmaṃtrya raghunaṃdanam .. 1 ..
5.100.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं भुक्त्वा स विप्रर्षिर्वांछया राममंदिरे ..
दत्ताशीर्निर्गतः पश्चादामंत्र्य रघुनंदनम् .. 1 ..
5.100.m: Sūta said: / Having eaten thus to his heart's desire in Rāma's palace, / the brahmin seer gave his blessing, took leave of the delighter of the Raghu lineage, and departed.

5.100.s:
atha yāte munau tasmindurvāsasi tadaṃtikāt ..
lakṣmaṇaḥ khaṅgamādāya rāmadevamuvāca ha .. 2 ..
5.100.d:
अथ याते मुनौ तस्मिन्दुर्वाससि तदंतिकात् ..
लक्ष्मणः खङ्गमादाय रामदेवमुवाच ह .. 2 ..
5.100.m: Then, when that sage Durvāsas had gone away from his presence, / Lakṣmaṇa took up a sword and said to Lord Rāma:

5.100.s:
etatkhaṅgaṃ gṛhītvāśu māṃ prabho vinipātaya ..
yena te syādṛtaṃ vākyaṃ pratijñātaṃ ca yatpurā .. 3 ..
5.100.d:
एतत्खङ्गं गृहीत्वाशु मां प्रभो विनिपातय ..
येन ते स्यादृतं वाक्यं प्रतिज्ञातं च यत्पुरा .. 3 ..
5.100.m: "Take this sword quickly, O lord, and strike me down, / so that your word and what was promised earlier may be true!"

5.100.s:
tato rāmaścirātsmṛtvā tāṃ pratijñāṃ svayaṃ kṛtām ..
vadhārthaṃ saṃpraviṣṭasya samīpe puruṣasya ca .. 4 ..
5.100.d:
ततो रामश्चिरात्स्मृत्वा तां प्रतिज्ञां स्वयं कृताम् ..
वधार्थं संप्रविष्टस्य समीपे पुरुषस्य च .. 4 ..
5.100.m: Then Rāma, after a long silence, remembered that promise made by himself / for the execution of any person who entered into their presence.

5.100.s:
tato'ticiṃtayāmāsa vyākulenāṃtarātmanā ..
bāṣpavyākulanetraśca niḥṣvasanpannago yathā .. 5 ..
5.100.d:
ततोऽतिचिंतयामास व्याकुलेनांतरात्मना ..
बाष्पव्याकुलनेत्रश्च निःष्वसन्पन्नगो यथा .. 5 ..
5.100.m: Then he pondered deeply with an agitated inner self, / his eyes disturbed with tears, sighing like a serpent.

5.100.s:
taṃ dīnavadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā niḥṣvasaṃtaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ..
bhūyaḥ provāca saumitrirvinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ .. 6 ..
5.100.d:
तं दीनवदनं दृष्ट्वा निःष्वसंतं मुहुर्मुहुः ..
भूयः प्रोवाच सौमित्रिर्विनयावनतः स्थितः .. 6 ..
5.100.m: Seeing his miserable face as he sighed repeatedly, / the son of Sumitrā, standing bowed down in humility, spoke again:

5.100.s:
eṣa eva paro dharmo bhūpatīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
yathātmīyaṃ vacastathyaṃ kriyate nirvikalpitam .. 7 ..
5.100.d:
एष एव परो धर्मो भूपतीनां विशेषतः ..
यथात्मीयं वचस्तथ्यं क्रियते निर्विकल्पितम् .. 7 ..
5.100.m: "This is the highest duty, especially of kings: / that one's own word must be made true, without hesitation.

5.100.s:
tasmāttvayā prabho proktaṃ svayameva mamāgrataḥ ..
tasyaiva devadūtasya tāranādena kopataḥ .. 9 ..
yo'trāgacchati saumitre mama dūtasya saṃnidhau ..
taṃ ceddhanmi svahastena nāhaṃ tasmātsupāpakṛt .. 9 ..
5.100.d:
तस्मात्त्वया प्रभो प्रोक्तं स्वयमेव ममाग्रतः ..
तस्यैव देवदूतस्य तारनादेन कोपतः .. 9 ..
योऽत्रागच्छति सौमित्रे मम दूतस्य संनिधौ ..
तं चेद्धन्मि स्वहस्तेन नाहं तस्मात्सुपापकृत् .. 9 ..
5.100.m:
Therefore, O lord, you yourself said in my presence, / loudly in anger, before that messenger of the gods:
'Whoever comes here, O son of Sumitrā, into the presence of my messenger, / if I kill him with my own hand, I shall not be a great sinner on that account.'

5.100.s:
tadahaṃ cāgatastāta bhayāddurvāsaso muneḥ ..
niṣiddho'pi tvayātīva tasmācchīghraṃ tu ghātaya .. 6.100.10 ..
5.100.d:
तदहं चागतस्तात भयाद्दुर्वाससो मुनेः ..
निषिद्धोऽपि त्वयातीव तस्माच्छीघ्रं तु घातय .. 6.100.10 ..
5.100.m: And so, dear brother, out of fear of the sage Durvāsas I came, / although strictly forbidden by you. Therefore, slay me quickly!"

5.100.s:
tataḥ saṃmaṃtrya suciraṃ maṃtribhiḥ sahito nṛpaḥ ..
brāhmaṇairdharmaśāstrajñaistathānyairvedapāragaiḥ .. 11 ..
5.100.d:
ततः संमंत्र्य सुचिरं मंत्रिभिः सहितो नृपः ..
ब्राह्मणैर्धर्मशास्त्रज्ञैस्तथान्यैर्वेदपारगैः .. 11 ..
5.100.m: Then, after deliberating for a long time together with his ministers, / with brahmins knowing the treatises on duty, and with others who had mastered the Vedas,

5.100.s:
provāca lakṣmaṇaṃ paścādvinayāvanataṃ sthitam ..
vāṣpaklinnamukho rāmo gadgadaṃ niḥśvasanmuhuḥ .. 12 ..
5.100.d:
प्रोवाच लक्ष्मणं पश्चाद्विनयावनतं स्थितम् ..
वाष्पक्लिन्नमुखो रामो गद्गदं निःश्वसन्मुहुः .. 12 ..
5.100.m: Rāma, his face wet with tears, sighing repeatedly and falteringly, / afterward spoke to Lakṣmaṇa as he stood bowed down in humility:

5.100.s:
vraja lakṣmaṇa muktastvaṃ mayā deśātaraṃ drutam ..
tyāgo vātha vadho vātha sādhūnāmubhayaṃ samam .. 13 ..
5.100.d:
व्रज लक्ष्मण मुक्तस्त्वं मया देशातरं द्रुतम् ..
त्यागो वाथ वधो वाथ साधूनामुभयं समम् .. 13 ..
5.100.m: "Go, Lakṣmaṇa! You are quickly banished by me to another country! / For the virtuous, abandonment or execution—both are equal.

5.100.s:
na mayā darśanaṃ bhūyastava kāryaṃ kathaṃcana ..
na sthātavyaṃ ca deśe'pi yadi me vāṃchasi priyam .. 14 ..
5.100.d:
न मया दर्शनं भूयस्तव कार्यं कथंचन ..
न स्थातव्यं च देशेऽपि यदि मे वांछसि प्रियम् .. 14 ..
5.100.m: I must never again catch sight of you in any way, / nor must you stay within this realm, if you wish to do what pleases me!"

5.100.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā praṇipatya tataḥ param ..
niryayau nagarāttasmāttatkṣaṇādeva lakṣmaṇaḥ .. 15 ..
5.100.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रणिपत्य ततः परम् ..
निर्ययौ नगरात्तस्मात्तत्क्षणादेव लक्ष्मणः .. 15 ..
5.100.m: Hearing his word, Lakṣmaṇa bowed down after that / and departed from that city that very moment,

5.100.s:
akṛtvāpi samālāpaṃ kenacinnijamaṃdire ..
mātrā vā bhāryayā vātha sutena suhṛdāthavā .. 16 ..
5.100.d:
अकृत्वापि समालापं केनचिन्निजमंदिरे ..
मात्रा वा भार्यया वाथ सुतेन सुहृदाथवा .. 16 ..
5.100.m: without even speaking to anyone in his own home, / whether his mother, or his wife, or his son, or a friend.

5.100.s:
tato'sau sarayūṃ gatvā'vagāhyātha ca tajjalam ..
śucirbhūtvā niviṣṭotha tattīre vijane śubhe .. 17 ..
5.100.d:
ततोऽसौ सरयूं गत्वाऽवगाह्याथ च तज्जलम् ..
शुचिर्भूत्वा निविष्टोथ तत्तीरे विजने शुभे .. 17 ..
5.100.m: Then, having gone to the Sarayū and bathed in its water, / becoming pure, he sat down upon its solitary, auspicious bank.

5.100.s:
padmāsanaṃ vidhāyātha nyasyātmānaṃ tathātmani ..
brahmadvāreṇa taṃ paścāttejorūpaṃ vyasarjayat .. 18 ..
5.100.d:
पद्मासनं विधायाथ न्यस्यात्मानं तथात्मनि ..
ब्रह्मद्वारेण तं पश्चात्तेजोरूपं व्यसर्जयत् .. 18 ..
5.100.m: Having assumed the lotus posture, fixing his self in the Self, / he then released his form of brilliance through the aperture of Brahmā.

5.100.s:
atha tadrāghavo dṛṣṭvā mahattejo viyadgatam ..
vismayena samāyukto'cintayatkimidaṃ tataḥ .. 19 ..
5.100.d:
अथ तद्राघवो दृष्ट्वा महत्तेजो वियद्गतम् ..
विस्मयेन समायुक्तोऽचिन्तयत्किमिदं ततः .. 19 ..
5.100.m: Then, seeing that great brilliance rising into the sky, / the descendant of Raghu was filled with wonder and thought: 'What is this?'

5.100.s:
atha martye parityakte tejasā tena tatkṣaṇāt ..
vaiṣṇavena turīyeṇa bhāgena dvijasattamāḥ .. 6.100.20 ..
5.100.d:
अथ मर्त्ये परित्यक्ते तेजसा तेन तत्क्षणात् ..
वैष्णवेन तुरीयेण भागेन द्विजसत्तमाः .. 6.100.20 ..
5.100.m: Then, when the mortal [form] was abandoned by that brilliance at that moment— / by that fourth portion of Viṣṇu, O best of brahmins—

5.100.s:
papāta bhūtale kāyaṃ kāṣṭhaloṣṭopamaṃ drutam..
lakṣmaṇasya gataśrīkaṃ sarayvāḥ puline śubhe .. 21 ..
5.100.d:
पपात भूतले कायं काष्ठलोष्टोपमं द्रुतम्..
लक्ष्मणस्य गतश्रीकं सरय्वाः पुलिने शुभे .. 21 ..
5.100.m: the body of Lakṣmaṇa, drained of its luster, like wood or a clod of earth, / fell swiftly upon the earth, on the auspicious sands of the Sarayū.

5.100.s:
tatastu rāghavaḥ śrutvā lakṣmaṇaṃ gatajīvitam ..
patitaṃ saritastīre vilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ .. 22 ..
5.100.d:
ततस्तु राघवः श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणं गतजीवितम् ..
पतितं सरितस्तीरे विललाप सुदुःखितः .. 22 ..
5.100.m: Then, hearing that Lakṣmaṇa was departed from life / and fallen upon the bank of the river, the descendant of Raghu lamented, deeply grieving.

5.100.s:
svayaṃ gatvā tamuddeśaṃ sāmātyaḥ sasuhṛjjanaḥ ..
lakṣmaṇaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā karuṇaṃ paryadevayat .. 23 ..
5.100.d:
स्वयं गत्वा तमुद्देशं सामात्यः ससुहृज्जनः ..
लक्ष्मणं पतितं दृष्ट्वा करुणं पर्यदेवयत् .. 23 ..
5.100.m: Going in person to that spot together with his ministers and friends, / seeing Lakṣmaṇa fallen, he wept piteously.

5.100.s:
hā vatsa māṃ parityajya kiṃ tvaṃ saṃprasthito divam ..
prāṇeṣṭaṃ bhrātaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sadā tava mate sthitam .. 24 ..
5.100.d:
हा वत्स मां परित्यज्य किं त्वं संप्रस्थितो दिवम् ..
प्राणेष्टं भ्रातरं श्रेष्ठं सदा तव मते स्थितम् .. 24 ..
5.100.m: “Ah, child! Having abandoned me, have you departed for heaven— / [your] elder brother, dear as life, who always stood by your counsel?

5.100.s:
tasminnapi mahāraṇye gacchamānaḥ purādaham ...?
api saṃdhāryamāṇena anuyātastvayā tadā .. 25 ..
5.100.d:
तस्मिन्नपि महारण्ये गच्छमानः पुरादहम् ...?
अपि संधार्यमाणेन अनुयातस्त्वया तदा .. 25 ..
5.100.m: Even when I was going through that great forest in the past, / I was followed by you, holding me up then.

5.100.s:
saṃprāpte'pi kabaṃdhākhye rākṣase balavattare ..
tvayā rātrimukhe ghore sabhāryo'haṃ prarakṣitaḥ .. 26 ..
5.100.d:
संप्राप्तेऽपि कबंधाख्ये राक्षसे बलवत्तरे ..
त्वया रात्रिमुखे घोरे सभार्योऽहं प्ररक्षितः .. 26 ..
5.100.m: Even when the most powerful rākṣasa named Kabandha approached, / at that dread twilight hour, I, together with my wife, was protected by you.

5.100.s:
yenendrajiddhato yuddhe tādṛgrūpo niśācaraḥ ..
sa eṣa patitaḥ śete gatāsurdharaṇītale .. 97 ..
yena śūrpaṇakhā dhvastā rākṣasī sā ca dāruṇā ..
līlayāpi mamādeśātsoyamevaṃvidhaḥ sthitaḥ .. 28 ..
yadbāhubalamāśritya mayā dhvastā niśācarāḥ ..
so'yaṃ nipatitaḥ śete mama bhrātā hyanāthavat ...? .. 29 ..
hā vatsa kva gato māṃ tvaṃ vimucya bhrātaraṃ nijam ..
jyeṣṭhaṃ prāṇasamaṃ kiṃ te sneho'dya vigataḥ kvacit .. 6.100.30 ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ bahuvidhānkṛtvā pralāpānraghunandanaḥ ..
mātṛbhiḥ sahito dīnaḥ śokena mahatānvitaḥ .. 31 ..
tataste maṃtriṇastasya procustaṃ vīkṣya duḥkhitam ...
vilapaṃtaṃ raghuśreṣṭhaṃ strījanena samanvitam .. 32 ..
.. maṃtriṇa ūcuḥ .. ..
mā śokaṃ kuru rājendra yathānyaḥ prākṛtaḥ sthitaḥ ..
kuruṣva ca yathedaṃ syātsāṃprataṃ caurdhvadaihikam.. 33 ..
5.100.d:
येनेन्द्रजिद्धतो युद्धे तादृग्रूपो निशाचरः ..
स एष पतितः शेते गतासुर्धरणीतले .. 97 ..
येन शूर्पणखा ध्वस्ता राक्षसी सा च दारुणा ..
लीलयापि ममादेशात्सोयमेवंविधः स्थितः .. 28 ..
यद्बाहुबलमाश्रित्य मया ध्वस्ता निशाचराः ..
सोऽयं निपतितः शेते मम भ्राता ह्यनाथवत् ...? .. 29 ..
हा वत्स क्व गतो मां त्वं विमुच्य भ्रातरं निजम् ..
ज्येष्ठं प्राणसमं किं ते स्नेहोऽद्य विगतः क्वचित् .. 6.100.30 ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं बहुविधान्कृत्वा प्रलापान्रघुनन्दनः ..
मातृभिः सहितो दीनः शोकेन महतान्वितः .. 31 ..
ततस्ते मंत्रिणस्तस्य प्रोचुस्तं वीक्ष्य दुःखितम् ...
विलपंतं रघुश्रेष्ठं स्त्रीजनेन समन्वितम् .. 32 ..
.. मंत्रिण ऊचुः .. ..
मा शोकं कुरु राजेन्द्र यथान्यः प्राकृतः स्थितः ..
कुरुष्व च यथेदं स्यात्सांप्रतं चौर्ध्वदैहिकम्.. 33 ..
5.100.m:
He by whom Indrajit was slain in battle, a night-roamer of such form— / that very one lies fallen on the ground, lifeless.
He by whom Śūrpaṇakhā, that cruel rākṣasī, was struck down / playfully at my command—that very one lies in such a state.
Relying on whose strength of arm I destroyed the night-roamers— / that very brother of mine lies fallen, like an orphan!
Ah, child! Where have you gone, abandoning me, your own elder brother / who is like your life? Where has your love gone today?”
Sūta said: / Having thus uttered many laments, the delight of the Raghus, / miserable, accompanied by his mothers, was overcome with great grief.
Then his ministers spoke, seeing him distressed, / the best of the Raghus lamenting together with the womenfolk.
The ministers said: / “Do not grieve, king of kings, standing like an ordinary commoner; / and act so that the funeral rites may now be performed.

5.100.s:
naṣṭaṃ mṛtamatītaṃ ca ye śocanti kubuddhayaḥ ..
dhīrāṇāṃ tu purā rājannaṣṭaṃ naṣṭaṃ mṛtaṃ mṛtam .. 34 ..
evaṃ te mantriṇaḥ procya tatastasya kalevaram ..
lakṣmaṇasya vilapyauccaiścandanośīrakuṃkumaiḥ .. 35 ..
karpūrāgurumiśraiśca tathānyaiḥ susugandhibhiḥ ..
pariveṣṭya śubhairvastraiḥ puṣpaiḥ saṃbhūṣya śobhanaiḥ .. 36 ..
candanāgurukāṣṭhaiśca citiṃ kṛtvā suvistarām ..
nyadadhustasya tadgātraṃ tatra dakṣiṇadiṅmukham .. 37 ..
etasminnaṃtare jātaṃ tatrāścaryaṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
tanme nigadataḥ sarvaṃ śṛṇvaṃtu sakalaṃ dvijāḥ .. 38 ..
yāvatteṃ'taḥ samāropya citāṃ tasya kalevaram ..
prayacchaṃti havirvāhaṃ tāvannaṣṭaṃ kalevaram .. 39 ..
etasminnaṃtare vāṇī nirgatā gaganāṃgaṇāt ..
nādayaṃtī diśaḥ sarvāḥ puṣpavarṣādanaṃtaram .. 6.100.40 ..
5.100.d:
नष्टं मृतमतीतं च ये शोचन्ति कुबुद्धयः ..
धीराणां तु पुरा राजन्नष्टं नष्टं मृतं मृतम् .. 34 ..
एवं ते मन्त्रिणः प्रोच्य ततस्तस्य कलेवरम् ..
लक्ष्मणस्य विलप्यौच्चैश्चन्दनोशीरकुंकुमैः .. 35 ..
कर्पूरागुरुमिश्रैश्च तथान्यैः सुसुगन्धिभिः ..
परिवेष्ट्य शुभैर्वस्त्रैः पुष्पैः संभूष्य शोभनैः .. 36 ..
चन्दनागुरुकाष्ठैश्च चितिं कृत्वा सुविस्तराम् ..
न्यदधुस्तस्य तद्गात्रं तत्र दक्षिणदिङ्मुखम् .. 37 ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे जातं तत्राश्चर्यं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
तन्मे निगदतः सर्वं शृण्वंतु सकलं द्विजाः .. 38 ..
यावत्तेंऽतः समारोप्य चितां तस्य कलेवरम् ..
प्रयच्छंति हविर्वाहं तावन्नष्टं कलेवरम् .. 39 ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वाणी निर्गता गगनांगणात् ..
नादयंती दिशः सर्वाः पुष्पवर्षादनंतरम् .. 6.100.40 ..
5.100.m:
Foolish are those who grieve for what is lost, dead, and departed. / But for the steadfast in the past, O king, what was lost was lost, and what was dead was dead.”
Having spoken thus, those ministers then took his corpse, / that of Lakṣmaṇa, weeping loudly; [and] with sandalwood, uśīra, and saffron,
mixed with camphor and agarwood, and other fragrant substances, / wrapping [it] in auspicious cloths and adorning [it] with splendid flowers,
and making an extensive pyre with sandalwood and agarwood logs, / they laid his body upon it, facing the southern direction.
Meanwhile a wonder occurred there, O best of brahmins; / let all the twice-born listen as I tell it completely.
As soon as they placed his corpse upon the pyre / and applied the fire, at that moment the corpse vanished.
At that moment a voice issued from the vault of the sky, / causing all the directions to resound, following a shower of flowers:

5.100.s:
rāmarāma mahābāho mā tvaṃ śokaparo bhava ..
na cāsya yujyate vahnirdātuṃ caiva kathaṃcana .. 41 ..
brahmajñānaprayuktasya saṃnyastasya viśeṣataḥ ..
agnidānaṃ na yuktaṃ syātsarveṣāmapi yoginām .. 42 ..
tavāyaṃ bāṃdhavo rāma brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ gataḥ.
brahmadvāreṇa cātmānaṃ niṣkramya sumahāyaśāḥ .. 43 ..
atha te maṃtriṇaḥ procustacchrutvā''kāśagaṃ vacaḥ ..
aśocyo yaṃ mahārāja saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gataḥ ..
lakṣmaṇo gamyatāṃ śīghraṃ tasmātsvabhavane vibho .. 44 ..
cintyantāṃ rājakāryāṇi tathā yaccaurdhvadaihikam ..
kuru snehocitaṃ tasya pṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇasattamān .. 45 ..
.. rāma uvāca ..
nāhaṃ gṛhaṃ gamiṣyāmi lakṣmaṇena vinā'dhunā ..
prāṇānatra vihāsyāmi yathā tena mahātmanā .. 46 ..
eṣa putro mayā dattaḥ kuśākhyo mama saṃmataḥ ..
yuṣmabhyaṃ kriyatāṃ rājye madīye yadi rocate .. 47 ..
5.100.d:
रामराम महाबाहो मा त्वं शोकपरो भव ..
न चास्य युज्यते वह्निर्दातुं चैव कथंचन .. 41 ..
ब्रह्मज्ञानप्रयुक्तस्य संन्यस्तस्य विशेषतः ..
अग्निदानं न युक्तं स्यात्सर्वेषामपि योगिनाम् .. 42 ..
तवायं बांधवो राम ब्रह्मणः सदनं गतः.
ब्रह्मद्वारेण चात्मानं निष्क्रम्य सुमहायशाः .. 43 ..
अथ ते मंत्रिणः प्रोचुस्तच्छ्रुत्वा'ऽकाशगं वचः ..
अशोच्यो यं महाराज संसिद्धिं परमां गतः ..
लक्ष्मणो गम्यतां शीघ्रं तस्मात्स्वभवने विभो .. 44 ..
चिन्त्यन्तां राजकार्याणि तथा यच्चौर्ध्वदैहिकम् ..
कुरु स्नेहोचितं तस्य पृष्ट्वा ब्राह्मणसत्तमान् .. 45 ..
.. राम उवाच ..
